ko.title: 7년의 지연: FAA의 737 MAX 7 승인이 보여주는 미국의 항공기 인증 방식의 실태

segments.src: On August 3, the Federal Aviation Administration issued an amended type certificate for the Boeing 737 MAX 7 — the smallest and, as it turned out, the slowest member of the MAX family to reach the finish line.
segments.tr: 8월 3일, 연방항공청(FAA)은 보잉 737 MAX 7에 대한 수정 형식 증명을 발급했습니다. 이 기종은 MAX 패밀리 중에서 가장 작고, 결과적으로 결승선에 가장 늦게 도달한 모델입니다.

segments.src: The jet was supposed to be carrying passengers in 2019.
segments.tr: 이 제트기는 2019년에 승객을 태울 예정이었습니다.

segments.src: It will not carry a paying one until 2027.
segments.tr: 하지만 2027년이 되어서야 유상 승객을 태우게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: That gap is the story.
segments.tr: 그 공백이 바로 핵심 이야기입니다.

segments.src: The MAX 7 is not a new airplane in any meaningful engineering sense; it is a shortened version of a variant that was already certified in 2017.
segments.tr: MAX 7은 엔지니어링 관점에서 새로운 비행기가 아닙니다. 2017년에 이미 인증을 받은 파생형의 동체를 짧게 줄인 버전입니다.

segments.src: And yet it took longer to approve than most clean-sheet designs take to build.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 완전히 새로운 설계(clean-sheet design)의 대부분을 제작하는 것보다 승인에 더 오랜 시간이 걸렸습니다.

segments.src: Understanding why is a useful window into how aircraft certification in the United States actually works now — and how much it has changed since the last decade.
segments.tr: 그 이유를 이해하는 것은 현재 미국의 항공기 인증이 실제로 어떻게 작동하는지, 그리고 지난 10년 동안 얼마나 많은 변화가 있었는지를 보여주는 유용한 창구입니다.

segments.src: ## A short jet with a long timeline
segments.tr: ## 긴 타임라인을 가진 짧은 제트기

segments.src: Boeing launched the MAX program in 2011 and the MAX 8 entered service in May 2017.
segments.tr: 보잉은 2011년에 MAX 프로그램을 시작했으며 MAX 8은 2017년 5월에 취항했습니다.

segments.src: The MAX 9 followed.
segments.tr: 그 뒤를 이어 MAX 9가 나왔습니다.

segments.src: The MAX 7 — sized for thinner routes and shorter runways, and pitched to Southwest Airlines as the eventual replacement for its aging fleet of 737-700s — first flew in March 2018 and was, at the time, expected to be delivered within a year.
segments.tr: 수요가 적은 노선과 짧은 활주로에 맞추어 설계되었고, 노후화된 737-700 기단을 대체할 최종 기종으로 사우스웨스트 항공에 제안된 MAX 7은 2018년 3월에 처음 비행했으며 당시에는 1년 이내에 인도될 것으로 예상되었습니다.

segments.src: Then came the two fatal accidents, in October 2018 and March 2019, that claimed 346 lives and led to a worldwide grounding of the MAX fleet for roughly 20 months.
segments.tr: 그러던 중 2018년 10스와 2019년 3월에 346명의 목숨을 앗아가고 전 세계 MAX 기단의 운항 중단으로 이어진 두 건의 치명적인 사고가 발생했습니다.

segments.src: The MAX 8 and MAX 9 returned to service in late 2020 after a redesign of the flight-control system.
segments.tr: MAX 8과 MAX 9는 비행 제어 시스템의 재설계를 거쳐 2020년 말에 운항을 재개했습니다.

segments.src: The MAX 7 did not simply resume its old certification track.
segments.tr: 그러나 MAX 7은 단순히 기존의 인증 과정을 재개하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: It restarted it, under rules that no longer resembled the ones it began under.
segments.tr: 처음 시작했을 때와는 전혀 닮지 않은 새로운 규칙 아래에서 처음부터 다시 시작했습니다.

segments.src: ## The three problems that had to be closed
segments.tr: ## 해결해야 했던 세 가지 문제

segments.src: According to the certification announcement, the program logged more than 1,000 hours of flight and ground testing in its final phase.
segments.tr: 인증 발표에 따르면, 이 프로그램은 최종 단계에서 1,000시간이 넘는 비행 및 지상 테스트를 기록했습니다.

segments.src: Three technical threads accounted for most of the delay.
segments.tr: 세 가지 기술적 문제가 지연의 대부분을 차지했습니다.

segments.src: **Flight-control software.** The system at the center of the 2018–2019 accidents, MCAS, was rewritten across the MAX fleet: it now compares both angle-of-attack sensors and stands down if they disagree, activates only once per event, and cannot override pilot input on the control column.
segments.tr: **비행 제어 소프트웨어.** 2018~2019년 사고의 중심에 있었던 시스템인 MCAS는 MAX 기단 전반에 걸쳐 재작성되었습니다. 이제 양쪽 받음각 센서를 비교하여 값이 다를 경우 작동을 멈추고, 이벤트당 한 번만 활성화되며, 조종사의 조종간 입력보다 우선시될 수 없습니다.

segments.src: The MAX 7 inherited that architecture, but inheriting it is not the same as being credited for it.
segments.tr: MAX 7은 그 아키텍처를 이어받았지만, 이어받았다는 것이 자동으로 승인을 의미하는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Every change had to be re-validated against the specific aerodynamics and weight-and-balance envelope of a shorter fuselage.
segments.tr: 짧아진 동체의 특정한 공기역학 및 중량·균형 외피(envelope)에 맞춰 모든 변경 사항을 재검증해야 했습니다.

segments.src: **Crew alerting.** In December 2020, Congress passed the Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, which required aircraft certified after December 2022 to carry a modern engine-indicating and crew-alerting system — the kind that prioritizes and plainly names a failure rather than lighting several unrelated warnings at once.
segments.tr: **승무원 경고 시스템.** 2020년 12월, 의회는 항공기 인증, 안전 및 책임법(ACSAA)을 통과시켰습니다. 이 법에 따라 2022년 12월 이후에 인증되는 항공기는 여러 개의 관련 없는 경고등을 한꺼번에 켜는 방식 대신, 고장을 우선순위별로 분류하고 명확하게 명시하는 현대적인 엔진 표시 및 승무원 경고 시스템을 갖추어야 했습니다.

segments.src: The MAX 7's flight deck is deliberately built to be common with the rest of the 737 fleet, so meeting that requirement outright would have broken the pilot-commonality argument that makes the airplane attractive to airlines in the first place.
segments.tr: MAX 7의 조종석은 737 기단의 다른 항공기들과 공통성을 유지하도록 의도적으로 설계되었기 때문에, 해당 요구사항을 곧이곧대로 충족했다면 항공사들이 이 비행기를 매력적으로 느끼게 만드는 조종사 공통성 논거가 깨졌을 것입니다.

segments.src: Congress ultimately granted the MAX 7 and MAX 10 relief from the deadline in late 2022, on the condition that Boeing add a set of flight-deck and alerting improvements across the MAX line.
segments.tr: 의회는 결국 2022년 말, 보잉이 MAX 기단 전반에 걸쳐 조종석 및 경고 시스템 개선 사항을 추가하는 것을 조건으로 MAX 7과 MAX 10에 마감일 유예를 부여했습니다.

segments.src: Those improvements became part of what the FAA had to review.
segments.tr: 그 개선 사항들이 FAA가 검토해야 하는 대상에 포함되었습니다.

segments.src: **Engine anti-ice.** The last and least expected obstacle was a nacelle.
segments.tr: **엔진 방빙.** 마지막이자 가장 예상치 못했던 장애물은 나셀이었습니다.

segments.src: Engineers determined that if the engine inlet anti-ice system were left running in dry air beyond a certain window, the composite inlet structure could overheat.
segments.tr: 엔지니어들은 엔진 흡입구 방빙 시스템이 특정 시간 범위를 넘어 건조한 공기 중에서 계속 작동할 경우 복합재 흡입구 구조물이 과열될 수 있음을 확인했습니다.

segments.src: Boeing asked the FAA in January 2024 for a time-limited exemption while it engineered a permanent fix, then withdrew the request weeks later amid public and congressional criticism that followed a separate in-flight panel failure on an Alaska Airlines MAX 9.
segments.tr: 보잉은 영구적인 수정 사항을 설계하는 동안 한시적 면제를 받기 위해 2024년 1월 FAA에 요청을 제기했으나, 알래스카 항공 MAX 9에서 발생한 별도의 비행 중 도어 플러그 이탈 사고 이후 대중과 의회의 비판이 쏟아지자 몇 주 만에 요청을 철회했습니다.

segments.src: The company committed instead to a hardware redesign.
segments.tr: 대신 회사는 하드웨어 재설계를 추진하기로 결정했습니다.

segments.src: That decision was almost certainly correct on the merits, and it cost the program most of two years.
segments.tr: 이 결정은 내용상 거의 확실히 옳았지만, 그 대가로 프로그램은 거의 2년을 허비하게 되었습니다.

segments.src: ## The quieter change: who does the certifying
segments.tr: ## 더 조용한 변화: 인증 주체

segments.src: The most consequential shift is the one that does not show up in any single fix.
segments.tr: 가장 중대한 변화는 단일한 수정 사항으로는 드러나지 않는 변화입니다.

segments.src: For decades, the FAA delegated large portions of certification work to Boeing employees under an Organization Designation Authorization — a system that let a company find and approve much of its own compliance evidence.
segments.tr: 수십 년 동안 FAA는 조직 지정 권한(ODA)을 통해 인증 업무의 상당 부분을 보잉 직원들에게 위임했습니다. 이 시스템을 통해 회사는 자체 준거성 입증 자료의 상당 부분을 직접 찾고 승인할 수 있었습니다.

segments.src: The 2020 reform law tightened that arrangement, adding FAA oversight of the delegated engineering unit, stronger protections for employees who raise safety concerns, and a requirement for a formal safety management system.
segments.tr: 2020년 개혁법은 이 체제를 강화하여, 위임된 엔지니어링 부서에 대한 FAA의 감독을 강화하고, 안전 문제를 제기하는 직원에 대한 보호를 강화하며, 공식적인 안전 관리 시스템 도입을 의무화했습니다.

segments.src: The practical result is that fewer findings are accepted on paper and more are demanded in the air.
segments.tr: 그 실질적인 결과로 서류상으로 받아들여지는 결과물은 줄어들고 공중에서의 검증을 요구하는 비중이 늘어났습니다.

segments.src: A thousand test hours for a shortened derivative of an already-certified airframe would have been unusual in 2016.
segments.tr: 이미 인증을 받은 기체의 단축형 파생형에 1,000시간의 테스트 시간을 소요하는 것은 2016년에는 이례적인 일이었을 것입니다.

segments.src: In 2026 it is close to the expected cost of doing business.
segments.tr: 그러나 2026년 현재 이는 비즈니스를 수행하기 위해 치러야 할 당연한 비용에 가깝습니다.

segments.src: ## Southwest's thirty parked airplanes
segments.tr: ## 사우스웨스트 항공의 주기된 비행기 서른 대

segments.src: The commercial arithmetic falls hardest on Southwest Airlines, the MAX 7's launch customer, which has roughly 30 completed aircraft sitting on the ground and will not begin taking deliveries until early 2027.
segments.tr: 상업적 손실은 MAX 7의 런칭 고객인 사우스웨스트 항공에 가장 큰 타격을 주었습니다. 이 항공사는 완성된 항공기 약 30대를 지상에 세워둔 채 2027년 초가 되어서야 인도를 받기 시작할 예정입니다.

segments.src: Those airframes represent capital that has been spent, insured, stored and maintained for years without producing a single block hour of revenue.
segments.tr: 그 기체들은 단 한 시간의 블록 타임(수익 운항 시간)도 창출하지 못한 채 수년 동안 지출되고, 보험에 가입되고, 보관 및 유지 관리된 자본을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Southwest's response over the past several years has been to keep flying older 737-700s longer than planned and to convert part of its order book to the larger MAX 8 — a rational hedge that also quietly changed the shape of its network, since a bigger airplane needs more passengers per departure to make sense.
segments.tr: 지난 몇 년간 사우스웨스트의 대응은 기존 737-700 기단을 계획보다 오래 운항하고 주문 물량의 일부를 더 큰 MAX 8로 전환하는 것이었습니다. 이는 합리적인 회피책이기도 했지만, 더 큰 비행기는 타당성을 확보하기 위해 출발당 더 많은 승객이 필요하기 때문에 노선망의 형태를 조용히 바꾸어 놓기도 했습니다.

segments.src: The MAX 7's arrival lets the airline restart a fleet-renewal plan that has been frozen since the end of the last decade, but on a slower clock and with newer, more expensive money.
segments.tr: MAX 7의 도입으로 항공사는 지난 10년말 이후 동결되었던 기단 갱신 계획을 재개할 수 있게 되었지만, 더 느린 속도로, 그리고 더 새롭고 비싼 자금을 투입해야 하게 되었습니다.

segments.src: For Boeing, certification converts inventory into cash, which matters for a company that has spent years burning it.
segments.tr: 보잉의 입장에서 인증은 재고를 현금으로 전환해 줍니다. 이는 수년 동안 현금을 소진해 온 회사에게 매우 중요한 문제입니다.

segments.src: But deliveries in early 2027 also mean the revenue arrives against a production system still recovering from post-2024 output limits, and stored aircraft typically need inspection and update work before they can be handed over.
segments.tr: 그러나 2027년 초의 인도는 2024년 이후의 생산량 제한에서 여전히 회복 중인 생산 시스템 속에서 수익이 발생함을 의미하며, 보관된 항공기는 대개 인도되기 전에 점검 및 업데이트 작업을 필요로 합니다.

segments.src: ## What it signals for the MAX 10 — and for everything after
segments.tr: ## MAX 10, 그리고 그 이후의 기종들에 시사하는 바

segments.src: The MAX 10, the longest member of the family, is still awaiting approval and faces the same crew-alerting condition and a distinct set of issues of its own, including its extending landing gear.
segments.tr: 패밀리 중 가장 긴 기종인 MAX 10은 여전히 승인을 기다리고 있으며, 동일한 승무원 경고 조건과 확장된 랜딩 기어를 포함한 독자적인 문제들에 직면해 있습니다.

segments.src: The MAX 7 outcome is the closest thing to a template available: expect the FAA to close every item rather than accept a deferral, and expect schedule commitments to be treated as forecasts rather than plans.
segments.tr: MAX 7의 결과는 사용할 수 있는 가장 가까운 청사진입니다. FAA가 유예를 수용하기보다는 모든 항목을 직접 해결할 것으로 예상하고, 일정 약속은 계획이라기보다는 예측으로 취급되어야 합니다.

segments.src: The wider question is what the right answer looks like.
segments.tr: 더 큰 질문은 올바른 해답이 어떤 모습인가 하는 것입니다.

segments.src: Seven years of slippage on a derivative aircraft is not something anyone designed on purpose.
segments.tr: 파생 항공기에서 7년의 지연은 누구도 고의로 설계한 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is the accumulated cost of rebuilding a certification process whose credibility had been damaged, plus one genuine engineering surprise, plus a legislative requirement that arrived mid-program.
segments.tr: 그것은 신뢰도가 손상된 인증 프로세스를 재구축하는 데 따른 누적된 비용과, 하나의 진정한 엔지니어링 놀라움, 그리고 프로그램 중간에 도입된 입법적 요구사항이 합쳐진 결과입니다.

segments.src: Reasonable people read the same facts differently: one view is that the system is now working as intended and the delay is the price of not repeating a catastrophic failure; another is that a process this unpredictable discourages manufacturers from building safer new designs at all, because the regulatory timeline cannot be estimated in advance.
segments.tr: 합리적인 사람들도 동일한 사실을 다르게 해석합니다. 한쪽에서는 시스템이 의도대로 작동하고 있으며 지연은 치명적인 실패를 반복하지 않기 위한 대가라고 보는 반면, 다른쪽에서는 이렇게 예측 불가능한 프로세스가 제조업체들이 규제 일정을 미리 예상할 수 없기 때문에 더 안전한 신형 설계를 아예 만들지 않도록 의욕을 꺾는다고 봅니다.

segments.src: Both can be true.
segments.tr: 두 주장 모두 맞을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: What the MAX 7 demonstrates is that in the United States today, a certificate is issued when the last open item is closed — not when the delivery slot was booked.
segments.tr: MAX 7이 보여주는 것은 오늘날 미국에서 인증서는 인도 슬롯이 예약되었을 때가 아니라 마지막 미해결 항목이 닫힐 때 발급된다는 사실입니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: - **Entry into service.** Certification is not the same as flying passengers; route-proving, crew training and the FAA's operational approvals still stand between the certificate and the first ticketed flight.
segments.tr: - **상업 운항 개시(Entry into service).** 인증은 승객을 태우는 것과 다릅니다. 증명 비행, 승무원 훈련, FAA의 운항 승인 등이 여전히 인증서와 첫 유상 비행 사이에 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Delivery pace through 2027.** How quickly stored airframes can be updated and handed over is a better indicator of Boeing's recovery than the certificate itself.
segments.tr: - **2027년까지의 인도 속도.** 보관된 기체가 얼마나 빠르게 업데이트되고 인도될 수 있는지가 인증서 자체보다 보잉의 회복을 보여주는 더 좋은 지표입니다.

segments.src: - **The MAX 10 decision.** Its treatment will show whether the MAX 7 review was a one-off catch-up or the new baseline.
segments.tr: - **MAX 10 결정.** MAX 10에 대한 처우는 MAX 7 검토가 일회성 따라잡기였는지 아니면 새로운 기준선이 되었는지를 보여줄 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Fleet-wide alerting upgrades.** The improvements attached to the 2022 congressional relief apply beyond one variant, and their rollout is the part of this story that touches airplanes already flying.
segments.tr: - **기단 전체의 경고 시스템 업그레이드.** 2022년 의회 구제 조치에 수반된 개선 사항들은 단일 파생형을 넘어 적용되며, 그 전개 과정은 이미 비행 중인 항공기들에 영향을 미치는 이야기의 한 부분입니다.

zh.title: 迟到七年：FAA 对 737 MAX 7 的批准揭示了美国如何认证飞机

segments.src: On August 3, the Federal Aviation Administration issued an amended type certificate for the Boeing 737 MAX 7 — the smallest and, as it turned out, the slowest member of the MAX family to reach the finish line.
segments.tr: 8 月 3 日，美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 为波音 737 MAX 7 颁发了修订后的型号证书 —— 这是 MAX 系列中最小且事实证明是最后到达终点的一员。

segments.src: The jet was supposed to be carrying passengers in 2019.
segments.tr: 这款喷气式飞机原定于 2019 年开始载客。

segments.src: It will not carry a paying one until 2027.
segments.tr: 但直到 2027 年，它才将迎来第一位付费乘客。

segments.src: That gap is the story.
segments.tr: 这段时间差就是故事的核心。

segments.src: The MAX 7 is not a new airplane in any meaningful engineering sense; it is a shortened version of a variant that was already certified in 2017.
segments.tr: 从任何有意义的工程学角度来看，MAX 7 都不是一架新飞机；它是 2017 年已经获得认证的某个变体版本的缩短版。

segments.src: And yet it took longer to approve than most clean-sheet designs take to build.
segments.tr: 然而，它的批准时间比大多数从零开始的设计所需的时间还要长。

segments.src: Understanding why is a useful window into how aircraft certification in the United States actually works now — and how much it has changed since the last decade.
segments.tr: 理解其中的原因，可以让我们洞察美国目前的飞机认证是如何运作的 —— 以及自上个十年以来它发生了多么大的变化。

segments.src: ## A short jet with a long timeline
segments.tr: ## 一个时间线漫长的短机身喷气机

segments.src: Boeing launched the MAX program in 2011 and the MAX 8 entered service in May 2017.
segments.tr: 波音在 2011 年启动了 MAX 项目，MAX 8 于 2017 年 5 月投入服务。

segments.src: The MAX 9 followed.
segments.tr: 随后是 MAX 9。

segments.src: The MAX 7 — sized for thinner routes and shorter runways, and pitched to Southwest Airlines as the eventual replacement for its aging fleet of 737-700s — first flew in March 2018 and was, at the time, expected to be delivered within a year.
segments.tr: MAX 7 —— 针对客流量较少的航线和较短的跑道而设计，并向西南航空推销作为其老旧 737-700 机队的最终替代方案 —— 于 2018 年 3 月首飞，当时预计在一年内交付。

segments.src: Then came the two fatal accidents, in October 2018 and March 2019, that claimed 346 lives and led to a worldwide grounding of the MAX fleet for roughly 20 months.
segments.tr: 随后发生了两起致命事故，分别在 2018 年 10 月和 2019 年 3 月，造成 346 人丧生，并导致 MAX 机队在全球范围内停飞约 20 个月。

segments.src: The MAX 8 and MAX 9 returned to service in late 2020 after a redesign of the flight-control system.
segments.tr: MAX 8 和 MAX 9 在飞行控制系统重新设计后，于 2020 年底恢复服务。

segments.src: The MAX 7 did not simply resume its old certification track.
segments.tr: MAX 7 并没有简单地恢复之前的认证路径。

segments.src: It restarted it, under rules that no longer resembled the ones it began under.
segments.tr: 它在不再像最初那样的一套新规则下重新开始了认证过程。

segments.src: ## The three problems that had to be closed
segments.tr: ## 必须解决的三个问题

segments.src: According to the certification announcement, the program logged more than 1,000 hours of flight and ground testing in its final phase.
segments.tr: 根据认证公告，该项目在最终阶段记录了 1,000 多个小时的飞行和地面测试。

segments.src: Three technical threads accounted for most of the delay.
segments.tr: 三个技术问题导致了大部分延迟。

segments.src: **Flight-control software.** The system at the center of the 2018–2019 accidents, MCAS, was rewritten across the MAX fleet: it now compares both angle-of-attack sensors and stands down if they disagree, activates only once per event, and cannot override pilot input on the control column.
segments.tr: **飞行控制软件。** 2018-2019 年事故的核心系统 MCAS 在整个 MAX 机队中被重写：它现在会对比两个攻角传感器，如果两者不一致则停止工作，每次事件仅激活一次，且不能覆盖飞行员在控制杆上的输入。

segments.src: The MAX 7 inherited that architecture, but inheriting it is not the same as being credited for it.
segments.tr: MAX 7 继承了该架构，但继承并不等同于直接获得认可。

segments.src: Every change had to be re-validated against the specific aerodynamics and weight-and-balance envelope of a shorter fuselage.
segments.tr: 每一项更改都必须针对较短机身的特定空气动力学以及重量和平衡包线重新验证。

segments.src: **Crew alerting.** In December 2020, Congress passed the Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, which required aircraft certified after December 2022 to carry a modern engine-indicating and crew-alerting system — the kind that prioritizes and plainly names a failure rather than lighting several unrelated warnings at once.
segments.tr: **机组警报。** 2020 年 12 月，国会通过了《飞机认证、安全与问责法案》，要求 2022 年 12 月之后认证的飞机必须配备现代化的发动机指示和机组警报系统 —— 这种系统能够优先排序并清晰地命名故障，而不是同时亮起多个无关的警告灯。

segments.src: The MAX 7's flight deck is deliberately built to be common with the rest of the 737 fleet, so meeting that requirement outright would have broken the pilot-commonality argument that makes the airplane attractive to airlines in the first place.
segments.tr: MAX 7 的驾驶舱被刻意设计为与 737 机队的其余部分通用，因此直接满足该要求将破坏“飞行员通用性”这一论点，而这正是该飞机对航空公司具有吸引力的原因。

segments.src: Congress ultimately granted the MAX 7 and MAX 10 relief from the deadline in late 2022, on the condition that Boeing add a set of flight-deck and alerting improvements across the MAX line.
segments.tr: 国会最终在 2022 年底允许 MAX 7 和 MAX 10 豁免该截止日期，条件是波音在整个 MAX 系列中增加一套驾驶舱和警报改进措施。

segments.src: Those improvements became part of what the FAA had to review.
segments.tr: 这些改进成为了 FAA 必须审查的内容。

segments.src: **Engine anti-ice.** The last and least expected obstacle was a nacelle.
segments.tr: **发动机防冰。** 最后一个且最出乎意料的障碍是发动机短舱。

segments.src: Engineers determined that if the engine inlet anti-ice system were left running in dry air beyond a certain window, the composite inlet structure could overheat.
segments.tr: 工程师确定，如果发动机进气道防冰系统在干燥空气中运行超过一定时间，复合材料进气道结构可能会过热。

segments.src: Boeing asked the FAA in January 2024 for a time-limited exemption while it engineered a permanent fix, then withdrew the request weeks later amid public and congressional criticism that followed a separate in-flight panel failure on an Alaska Airlines MAX 9.
segments.tr: 波音在 2024 年 1 月向 FAA 申请了限时豁免，以便在设计永久修复方案期间使用，但几周后，在阿拉斯加航空一架 MAX 9 发生单独的飞行中面板脱落事故后，面对公众和国会的批评，波音撤回了该申请。

segments.src: The company committed instead to a hardware redesign.
segments.tr: 公司转而承诺进行硬件重新设计。

segments.src: That decision was almost certainly correct on the merits, and it cost the program most of two years.
segments.tr: 从道理上讲，这个决定几乎肯定是正确的，但它让该项目损失了近两年的时间。

segments.src: ## The quieter change: who does the certifying
segments.tr: ## 更隐秘的变化：谁在进行认证

segments.src: The most consequential shift is the one that does not show up in any single fix.
segments.tr: 最深远的影响在于那些没有体现在任何单一修复方案中的变化。

segments.src: For decades, the FAA delegated large portions of certification work to Boeing employees under an Organization Designation Authorization — a system that let a company find and approve much of its own compliance evidence.
segments.tr: 几十年来，FAA 通过“组织指定授权” (ODA) 将大部分认证工作委托给波音员工，这一系统允许公司自行寻找并批准大部分合规性证据。

segments.src: The 2020 reform law tightened that arrangement, adding FAA oversight of the delegated engineering unit, stronger protections for employees who raise safety concerns, and a requirement for a formal safety management system.
segments.tr: 2020 年的改革法律收紧了这一安排，增加了 FAA 对受托工程部门的监督，加强了对提出安全担忧员工的保护，并要求建立正式的安全管理系统。

segments.src: The practical result is that fewer findings are accepted on paper and more are demanded in the air.
segments.tr: 实际结果是，纸面上的结论被接受的次数减少了，而对飞行测试的要求增加了。

segments.src: A thousand test hours for a shortened derivative of an already-certified airframe would have been unusual in 2016.
segments.tr: 在 2016 年，对于一个已经获得认证的机身的缩短衍生型号，进行一千小时的测试飞行将是非常罕见的。

segments.src: In 2026 it is close to the expected cost of doing business.
segments.tr: 但在 2026 年，这已接近于开展业务的预期成本。

segments.src: ## Southwest's thirty parked airplanes
segments.tr: ## 西南航空的 30 架停机飞机

segments.src: The commercial arithmetic falls hardest on Southwest Airlines, the MAX 7's launch customer, which has roughly 30 completed aircraft sitting on the ground and will not begin taking deliveries until early 2027.
segments.tr: 商业计算的打击最沉重的是 MAX 7 的启动客户西南航空，该公司目前约有 30 架已完工的飞机停在地面上，直到 2027 年初才会开始接收交付。

segments.src: Those airframes represent capital that has been spent, insured, stored and maintained for years without producing a single block hour of revenue.
segments.tr: 这些机身代表了已经支出、投保、存储和维护多年的资金，却未产生一个小时的收入。

segments.src: Southwest's response over the past several years has been to keep flying older 737-700s longer than planned and to convert part of its order book to the larger MAX 8 — a rational hedge that also quietly changed the shape of its network, since a bigger airplane needs more passengers per departure to make sense.
segments.tr: 西南航空在过去几年的应对措施是延长老旧 737-700 的飞行时间，并将部分订单转换为较大的 MAX 8 —— 这是一个理性的对冲方案，但也悄悄改变了其航线网络的形态，因为更大的飞机在每次起飞时需要更多乘客才能盈利。

segments.src: The MAX 7's arrival lets the airline restart a fleet-renewal plan that has been frozen since the end of the last decade, but on a slower clock and with newer, more expensive money.
segments.tr: MAX 7 的到来让航空公司能够重启自上个十年末以来一直冻结的机队更新计划，但进度更慢，且资金成本更高。

segments.src: For Boeing, certification converts inventory into cash, which matters for a company that has spent years burning it.
segments.tr: 对于波音公司来说，认证将库存转化为现金，这对于一家多年来一直在烧钱的公司来说至关重要。

segments.src: But deliveries in early 2027 also mean the revenue arrives against a production system still recovering from post-2024 output limits, and stored aircraft typically need inspection and update work before they can be handed over.
segments.tr: 但 2027 年初的交付也意味着收入将面对一个仍在从 2024 年后产量限制中恢复的生产系统，而且存储的飞机在交付前通常需要检查和更新工作。

segments.src: ## What it signals for the MAX 10 — and for everything after
segments.tr: ## 对 MAX 10 的信号 —— 以及之后的一切

segments.src: The MAX 10, the longest member of the family, is still awaiting approval and faces the same crew-alerting condition and a distinct set of issues of its own, including its extending landing gear.
segments.tr: MAX 10 作为该系列中最长的成员，仍在等待批准，并面临相同的机组警报条件以及一套独特的自身问题，包括其可延伸起落架。

segments.src: The MAX 7 outcome is the closest thing to a template available: expect the FAA to close every item rather than accept a deferral, and expect schedule commitments to be treated as forecasts rather than plans.
segments.tr: MAX 7 的结果是目前最接近的模板：预计 FAA 将关闭每一个项目而不是接受推迟，并且预计进度承诺将被视为预测而非计划。

segments.src: The wider question is what the right answer looks like.
segments.tr: 更广泛的问题是，正确答案应该是怎样的。

segments.src: Seven years of slippage on a derivative aircraft is not something anyone designed on purpose.
segments.tr: 衍生机型出现七年的延迟并非任何人故意设计的。

segments.src: It is the accumulated cost of rebuilding a certification process whose credibility had been damaged, plus one genuine engineering surprise, plus a legislative requirement that arrived mid-program.
segments.tr: 这是重建一个信誉受损的认证过程的累积成本，加上一个真实的工程意外，以及一个在项目中期出现的立法要求。

segments.src: Reasonable people read the same facts differently: one view is that the system is now working as intended and the delay is the price of not repeating a catastrophic failure; another is that a process this unpredictable discourages manufacturers from building safer new designs at all, because the regulatory timeline cannot be estimated in advance.
segments.tr: 理智的人对同样的事实有不同的解读：一种观点认为系统现在正按预期运作，延迟是避免重复灾难性失败的代价；另一种观点则认为，如此不可预测的过程会挫伤制造商开发更安全新设计的积极性，因为监管时间线无法提前估算。

segments.src: Both can be true.
segments.tr: 两者都可能是正确的。

segments.src: What the MAX 7 demonstrates is that in the United States today, a certificate is issued when the last open item is closed — not when the delivery slot was booked.
segments.tr: MAX 7 证明了在今天的美国，证书是在最后一个开放项目关闭时颁发的 —— 而不是在预订交付时限时颁发的。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 下一步关注重点

segments.src: - **Entry into service.** Certification is not the same as flying passengers; route-proving, crew training and the FAA's operational approvals still stand between the certificate and the first ticketed flight.
segments.tr: - **投入服务。** 认证并不等同于载客飞行；在获得证书和首次商业飞行之间，仍有航线验证、机组培训和 FAA 的运行批准。

segments.src: - **Delivery pace through 2027.** How quickly stored airframes can be updated and handed over is a better indicator of Boeing's recovery than the certificate itself.
segments.tr: - **直到 2027 年的交付速度。** 存储机身更新和移交的速度，比证书本身更能反映波音的恢复情况。

segments.src: - **The MAX 10 decision.** Its treatment will show whether the MAX 7 review was a one-off catch-up or the new baseline.
segments.tr: - **MAX 10 的决定。** 对它的处理方式将显示 MAX 7 的审查是否是一次性的补课，还是成为了新的基准。

segments.src: - **Fleet-wide alerting upgrades.** The improvements attached to the 2022 congressional relief apply beyond one variant, and their rollout is the part of this story that touches airplanes already flying.
segments.tr: - **全机队警报升级。** 与 2022 年国会豁免相关的改进适用于除一个变体之外的更多型号，其推广情况是这个故事中涉及已在飞行飞机的一部分。

segments.tr: *本文为基于 2026 年 8 月 5 日公开报道信息的通用新闻分析。

segments.src: Certification and delivery schedules are set by the FAA, Boeing and individual airlines and can change; readers should consult official announcements from those organizations for operational details.*

segments.tr: वह अंतर ही कहानी है।

segments.src: The MAX 7 is not a new airplane in any meaningful engineering sense; it is a shortened version of a variant that was already certified in 2017.
segments.tr: MAX 7 किसी भी सार्थक इंजीनियरिंग अर्थ में कोई नया हवाई जहाज नहीं है; यह एक ऐसे संस्करण का छोटा किया गया संस्करण है जिसे पहले ही 2017 में प्रमाणित किया जा चुका था।

segments.src: And yet it took longer to approve than most clean-sheet designs take to build.
segments.tr: और फिर भी इसे स्वीकृत होने में अधिकांश पूरी तरह से नए डिज़ाइनों को बनाने से अधिक समय लगा।

segments.src: Understanding why is a useful window into how aircraft certification in the United States actually works now — and how much it has changed since the last decade.
segments.tr: यह समझना एक उपयोगी खिड़की है कि संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में विमान प्रमाणन वास्तव में अब कैसे काम करता है - और पिछले दशक के बाद से यह कितना बदल गया है।

segments.src: ## A short jet with a long timeline
segments.tr: ## एक लंबी समय सीमा वाला एक छोटा जेट

segments.src: Boeing launched the MAX program in 2011 and the MAX 8 entered service in May 2017.
segments.tr: बोइंग ने 2011 में MAX कार्यक्रम शुरू किया और MAX 8 ने मई 2017 में सेवा में प्रवेश किया।

segments.src: The MAX 9 followed.
segments.tr: इसके बाद MAX 9 आया।

segments.src: The MAX 7 — sized for thinner routes and shorter runways, and pitched to Southwest Airlines as the eventual replacement for its aging fleet of 737-700s — first flew in March 2018 and was, at the time, expected to be delivered within a year.
segments.tr: कम यातायात वाले मार्गों और छोटे रनवे के लिए आकार दिया गया, और साउथवेस्ट एयरलाइंस को इसके 737-700 के पुराने बेड़े के संभावित प्रतिस्थापन के रूप में पेश किया गया - MAX 7 ने पहली बार मार्च 2018 में उड़ान भरी और उस समय, एक साल के भीतर डिलीवर होने की उम्मीद थी।

segments.src: Then came the two fatal accidents, in October 2018 and March 2019, that claimed 346 lives and led to a worldwide grounding of the MAX fleet for roughly 20 months.
segments.tr: फिर अक्टूबर 2018 और मार्च 2019 में दो घातक दुर्घटनाएँ हुईं, जिनमें 346 लोगों की जान चली गई और लगभग 20 महीनों के लिए MAX बेड़े को दुनिया भर में ग्राउंड करना पड़ा।

segments.src: The MAX 8 and MAX 9 returned to service in late 2020 after a redesign of the flight-control system.
segments.tr: फ्लाईट-कंट्रोल सिस्टम के पुनरुत्थान के बाद MAX 8 और MAX 9 ने 2020 के अंत में सेवा फिर से शुरू की।

segments.src: The MAX 7 did not simply resume its old certification track.
segments.tr: MAX 7 ने सीधे तौर पर अपने पुराने प्रमाणन ट्रैक को फिर से शुरू नहीं किया।

segments.src: It restarted it, under rules that no longer resembled the ones it began under.
segments.tr: इसने इसे उन नियमों के तहत पुनरारंभ किया, जो अब उन नियमों से मेल नहीं खाते थे जिनके तहत इसने शुरुआत की थी।

segments.src: ## The three problems that had to be closed
segments.tr: ## वे तीन समस्याएं जिन्हें बंद करना पड़ा

segments.src: According to the certification announcement, the program logged more than 1,000 hours of flight and ground testing in its final phase.
segments.tr: प्रमाणन घोषणा के अनुसार, कार्यक्रम ने अपने अंतिम चरण में 1,000 घंटे से अधिक की उड़ान और जमीन पर परीक्षण दर्ज किए।

segments.src: Three technical threads accounted for most of the delay.
segments.tr: तीन तकनीकी धागों ने अधिकांश देरी के लिए जिम्मेदार ठहराया।

segments.src: **Flight-control software.** The system at the center of the 2018–2019 accidents, MCAS, was rewritten across the MAX fleet: it now compares both angle-of-attack sensors and stands down if they disagree, activates only once per event, and cannot override pilot input on the control column.
segments.tr: **Flight-control software.** 2018-2019 की दुर्घटनाओं के केंद्र में मौजूद सिस्टम, MCAS को MAX बेड़े में फिर से लिखा गया था: यह अब दोनों एंगल-ऑफ-अटैक सेंसर की तुलना करता है और यदि वे असहमत होते हैं तो खड़े हो जाते हैं, प्रति घटना केवल एक बार सक्रिय होते हैं, और नियंत्रण कॉलम पर पायलट इनपुट को ओवरराइड नहीं कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: The MAX 7 inherited that architecture, but inheriting it is not the same as being credited for it.
segments.tr: MAX 7 को वह वास्तुकला विरासत में मिली, लेकिन इसे विरासत में पाना इसके लिए श्रेय दिए जाने के समान नहीं है।

segments.src: Every change had to be re-validated against the specific aerodynamics and weight-and-balance envelope of a shorter fuselage.
segments.tr: छोटे धड़ की विशिष्ट वायुगतिकी और वजन-और-संतुलन लिफाफे के खिलाफ हर बदलाव को फिर से मान्य किया जाना था।

segments.src: **Crew alerting.** In December 2020, Congress passed the Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, which required aircraft certified after December 2022 to carry a modern engine-indicating and crew-alerting system — the kind that prioritizes and plainly names a failure rather than lighting several unrelated warnings at once.
segments.tr: **Crew alerting.** दिसंबर 2020 में, कांग्रेस ने एयरक्राफ्ट सर्टिफिकेशन, सेफ्टी, एंड अकाउंटेबिलिटी एक्ट पारित किया, जिसके तहत दिसंबर 2022 के बाद प्रमाणित विमानों को एक आधुनिक इंजन-इंगित और क्रू-अलर्टिंग सिस्टम ले जाने की आवश्यकता थी - जिस तरह का सिस्टम एक बार में कई असंबंधित चेतावनियों को प्रकाश में लाने के बजाय विफलता को प्राथमिकता देता है और स्पष्ट रूप से नाम देता है।

segments.src: The MAX 7's flight deck is deliberately built to be common with the rest of the 737 fleet, so meeting that requirement outright would have broken the pilot-commonality argument that makes the airplane attractive to airlines in the first place.
segments.tr: MAX 7 का फ़्लाइट डेक जानबूझकर 737 बेड़े के बाकी हिस्सों के साथ सामान्य होने के लिए बनाया गया है, इसलिए उस आवश्यकता को पूरी तरह से पूरा करने से पायलट-समानता तर्क टूट जाता है जो विमान को पहली बार में एयरलाइंस के लिए आकर्षक बनाता है।

segments.src: Congress ultimately granted the MAX 7 and MAX 10 relief from the deadline in late 2022, on the condition that Boeing add a set of flight-deck and alerting improvements across the MAX line.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस ने अंततः 2022 के अंत में MAX 7 और MAX 10 को समय सीमा से राहत दी, इस शर्त पर कि बोइंग MAX लाइन में फ़्लाइट-डेक और अलर्टिंग सुधारों का एक सेट जोड़े।

segments.src: Those improvements became part of what the FAA had to review.
segments.tr: वे सुधार उस चीज़ का हिस्सा बन गए जिसकी समीक्षा FAA को करनी थी।

segments.src: **Engine anti-ice.** The last and least expected obstacle was a nacelle.
segments.tr: **Engine anti-ice.** अंतिम और कम से कम अपेक्षित बाधा एक नैकेल थी।

segments.src: Engineers determined that if the engine inlet anti-ice system were left running in dry air beyond a certain window, the composite inlet structure could overheat.
segments.tr: इंजीनियरों ने निर्धारित किया कि यदि इंजन इनलेट एंटी-आइस सिस्टम को एक निश्चित खिड़की से परे सूखी हवा में चल रहा छोड़ दिया जाए, तो समग्र इनलेट संरचना ज़्यादा गरम हो सकती है।

segments.src: Boeing asked the FAA in January 2024 for a time-limited exemption while it engineered a permanent fix, then withdrew the request weeks later amid public and congressional criticism that followed a separate in-flight panel failure on an Alaska Airlines MAX 9.
segments.tr: बोइंग ने जनवरी 2024 में FAA से एक समयबद्ध छूट के लिए कहा, जबकि इसने एक स्थायी सुधार का इंजीनियर किया, फिर अलास्का एयरलाइंस MAX 9 पर एक अलग इन-फ्लाइट पैनल विफलता के बाद सार्वजनिक और कांग्रेसनल आलोचना के बीच हफ्तों बाद अनुरोध वापस ले लिया।

segments.src: The company committed instead to a hardware redesign.
segments.tr: कंपनी ने इसके बजाय हार्डवेयर रीडिजाइन के लिए प्रतिबद्ध किया।

segments.src: That decision was almost certainly correct on the merits, and it cost the program most of two years.
segments.tr: वह निर्णय लगभग निश्चित रूप से योग्यता पर सही था, और इसने कार्यक्रम को दो साल का अधिकांश हिस्सा खर्च किया।

segments.src: ## The quieter change: who does the certifying
segments.tr: ## शांत परिवर्तन: प्रमाणन कौन करता है

segments.src: The most consequential shift is the one that does not show up in any single fix.
segments.tr: सबसे परिणामी बदलाव वह है जो किसी एक सुधार में नहीं दिखाई देता है।

segments.src: For decades, the FAA delegated large portions of certification work to Boeing employees under an Organization Designation Authorization — a system that let a company find and approve much of its own compliance evidence.
segments.tr: दशकों से, FAA ने संगठन पदनाम प्राधिकरण के तहत बोइंग कर्मचारियों को प्रमाणन कार्य के बड़े हिस्से को प्रत्यायोजित किया - एक ऐसी प्रणाली जो एक कंपनी को अपने स्वयं के अनुपालन साक्ष्य का एक बहुत खोजने और अनुमोदित करने देती है।

segments.src: The 2020 reform law tightened that arrangement, adding FAA oversight of the delegated engineering unit, stronger protections for employees who raise safety concerns, and a requirement for a formal safety management system.
segments.tr: 2020 के सुधार कानून ने उस व्यवस्था को कड़ा कर दिया, जिसमें प्रत्यायोजित इंजीनियरिंग इकाई की FAA निगरानी, सुरक्षा चिंताओं को उठाने वाले कर्मचारियों के लिए मजबूत सुरक्षा, और एक औपचारिक सुरक्षा प्रबंधन प्रणाली की आवश्यकता को जोड़ा गया।

segments.src: The practical result is that fewer findings are accepted on paper and more are demanded in the air.
segments.tr: व्यावहारिक परिणाम यह है कि कागज़ पर कम निष्कर्ष स्वीकार किए जाते हैं और हवा में अधिक मांग की जाती है।

segments.src: A thousand test hours for a shortened derivative of an already-certified airframe would have been unusual in 2016.
segments.tr: पहले से प्रमाणित एयरफ़्रेम के छोटे व्युत्पत्ति के लिए एक हजार परीक्षण घंटे 2016 में असामान्य रहे होंगे।

segments.src: In 2026 it is close to the expected cost of doing business.
segments.tr: 2026 में यह व्यापार करने की अपेक्षित लागत के करीब है।

segments.src: ## Southwest's thirty parked airplanes
segments.tr: ## साउथवेस्ट के तीस पार्क किए गए हवाई जहाज

segments.src: The commercial arithmetic falls hardest on Southwest Airlines, the MAX 7's launch customer, which has roughly 30 completed aircraft sitting on the ground and will not begin taking deliveries until early 2027.
segments.tr: वाणिज्यिक अंकगणित साउथवेस्ट एयरलाइंस पर सबसे कठिन पड़ता है, जो MAX 7 का लॉन्च ग्राहक है, जिसके पास लगभग 30 पूर्ण विमान जमीन पर बैठे हैं और 2027 की शुरुआत तक डिलीवरी लेना शुरू नहीं करेंगे।

segments.src: Those airframes represent capital that has been spent, insured, stored and maintained for years without producing a single block hour of revenue.
segments.tr: वे एयरफ़्रेम उस पूंजी का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं जिसे राजस्व का एक भी ब्लॉक घंटा उत्पन्न किए बिना वर्षों से खर्च किया गया है, बीमा किया गया है, संग्रहीत किया गया है और बनाए रखा गया है।

segments.src: Southwest's response over the past several years has been to keep flying older 737-700s longer than planned and to convert part of its order book to the larger MAX 8 — a rational hedge that also quietly changed the shape of its network, since a bigger airplane needs more passengers per departure to make sense.
segments.tr: पिछले कई वर्षों में साउथवेस्ट की प्रतिक्रिया पुराने 737-700s को योजना से अधिक समय तक उड़ते रहने और अपने ऑर्डर बुक के हिस्से को बड़े MAX 8 में बदलने की रही है - एक तर्कसंगत हेज जिसने चुपचाप अपने नेटवर्क के आकार को भी बदल दिया है, क्योंकि एक बड़े हवाई जहाज को समझ में आने के लिए प्रति प्रस्थान अधिक यात्रियों की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: The MAX 7's arrival lets the airline restart a fleet-renewal plan that has been frozen since the end of the last decade, but on a slower clock and with newer, more expensive money.
segments.tr: MAX 7 का आगमन एयरलाइन को एक बेड़े-नवीनीकरण योजना को फिर से शुरू करने देता है जो पिछले दशक के अंत से जमी हुई है, लेकिन एक धीमी घड़ी पर और नए, अधिक महंगे पैसों के साथ।

segments.src: For Boeing, certification converts inventory into cash, which matters for a company that has spent years burning it.
segments.tr: बोइंग के लिए, प्रमाणन इन्वेंट्री को नकदी में परिवर्तित करता है, जो एक ऐसी कंपनी के लिए मायने रखता है जिसने इसे जलाने में वर्षों बिताए हैं।

segments.src: But deliveries in early 2027 also mean the revenue arrives against a production system still recovering from post-2024 output limits, and stored aircraft typically need inspection and update work before they can be handed over.
segments.tr: लेकिन 2027 की शुरुआत में डिलीवरी का मतलब यह भी है कि राजस्व 2024 के बाद के उत्पादन सीमा से उबरने वाली उत्पादन प्रणाली के खिलाफ आता है, और संग्रहीत विमानों को सौंपे जाने से पहले आम तौर पर निरीक्षण और अद्यतन काम की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: ## What it signals for the MAX 10 — and for everything after
segments.tr: ## यह MAX 10 के लिए क्या संकेत देता है - और इसके बाद की हर चीज़ के लिए

segments.src: The MAX 10, the longest member of the family, is still awaiting approval and faces the same crew-alerting condition and a distinct set of issues of its own, including its extending landing gear.
segments.tr: MAX 10, परिवार का सबसे लंबा सदस्य, अभी भी अनुमोदन की प्रतीक्षा कर रहा है और उसी क्रू-अलर्टिंग स्थिति का सामना कर रहा है और अपने स्वयं के मुद्दों का एक अलग सेट है, जिसमें इसके विस्तार वाले लैंडिंग गियर शामिल हैं।

segments.src: The MAX 7 outcome is the closest thing to a template available: expect the FAA to close every item rather than accept a deferral, and expect schedule commitments to be treated as forecasts rather than plans.
segments.tr: MAX 7 का परिणाम उपलब्ध टेम्पलेट के सबसे करीब है: उम्मीद है कि FAA स्थगन स्वीकार करने के बजाय प्रत्येक आइटम को बंद कर देगा, और शेड्यूल प्रतिबद्धताओं को योजनाओं के बजाय पूर्वानुमानों के रूप में माना जाने की उम्मीद है।

segments.src: The wider question is what the right answer looks like.
segments.tr: व्यापक सवाल यह है कि सही उत्तर कैसा दिखता है।

segments.src: Seven years of slippage on a derivative aircraft is not something anyone designed on purpose.
segments.tr: एक व्युत्पत्ति विमान पर सात साल की फिसलन ऐसी चीज नहीं है जिसे किसी ने जानबूझकर डिजाइन किया हो।

segments.src: It is the accumulated cost of rebuilding a certification process whose credibility had been damaged, plus one genuine engineering surprise, plus a legislative requirement that arrived mid-program.
segments.tr: यह एक प्रमाणन प्रक्रिया को फिर से बनाने की संचित लागत है जिसकी विश्वसनीयता को नुकसान पहुँचाया गया था, साथ ही एक वास्तविक इंजीनियरिंग आश्चर्य, और एक विधायी आवश्यकता जो कार्यक्रम के बीच में आई।

segments.src: Reasonable people read the same facts differently: one view is that the system is now working as intended and the delay is the price of not repeating a catastrophic failure; another is that a process this unpredictable discourages manufacturers from building safer new designs at all, because the regulatory timeline cannot be estimated in advance.
segments.tr: उचित लोग एक ही तथ्यों को अलग तरह से पढ़ते हैं: एक दृश्य यह है कि प्रणाली अब इच्छित रूप से काम कर रही है और देरी एक विनाशकारी विफलता को नहीं दोहराने की कीमत है; दूसरा यह है कि इस तरह की अप्रत्याशित प्रक्रिया निर्माताओं को सुरक्षित नए डिजाइन बनाने से हतोत्साहित करती है, क्योंकि नियामक समयसीमा का अनुमान पहले से नहीं लगाया जा सकता है।

segments.src: Both can be true.
segments.tr: दोनों सच हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: What the MAX 7 demonstrates is that in the United States today, a certificate is issued when the last open item is closed — not when the delivery slot was booked.
segments.tr: MAX 7 जो प्रदर्शित करता है वह यह है कि आज संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में, एक प्रमाण पत्र तब जारी किया जाता है जब अंतिम खुली वस्तु बंद हो जाती है - न कि जब डिलीवरी स्लॉट बुक किया गया था।

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **Entry into service.** Certification is not the same as flying passengers; route-proving, crew training and the FAA's operational approvals still stand between the certificate and the first ticketed flight.
segments.tr: - **Entry into service.** प्रमाणन यात्रियों को उड़ाने के समान नहीं है; मार्ग-साबित करना, चालक दल का प्रशिक्षण और FAA की परिचालन स्वीकृतियां अभी भी प्रमाण पत्र और पहली टिकट वाली उड़ान के बीच खड़ी हैं।

segments.src: - **Delivery pace through 2027.** How quickly stored airframes can be updated and handed over is a better indicator of Boeing's recovery than the certificate itself.
segments.tr: - **Delivery pace through 2027.** संग्रहीत एयरफ़्रेम को कितनी जल्दी अद्यतन और सुपुर्द किया जा सकता है, यह प्रमाण पत्र की तुलना में बोइंग की रिकवरी का एक बेहतर संकेतक है।

segments.src: - **The MAX 10 decision.** Its treatment will show whether the MAX 7 review was a one-off catch-up or the new baseline.
segments.tr: - **The MAX 10 decision.** इसका उपचार यह दिखाएगा कि MAX 7 समीक्षा एक बार की कैच-अप थी या नया बेसलाइन।

segments.src: - **Fleet-wide alerting upgrades.** The improvements attached to the 2022 congressional relief apply beyond one variant, and their rollout is the part of this story that touches airplanes already flying.
segments.tr: - **Fleet-wide alerting upgrades.** 2022 की कांग्रेसनल राहत से जुड़े सुधार एक संस्करण से परे लागू होते हैं, और उनका रोलआउट इस कहानी का वह हिस्सा है जो पहले से उड़ रहे हवाई जहाजों को छूता है।

es.title: Siete años tarde: Lo que revela la aprobación del 737 MAX 7 de la FAA sobre cómo Estados Unidos certifica los aviones

segments.src: On August 3, the Federal Aviation Administration issued an amended type certificate for the Boeing 737 MAX 7 — the smallest and, as it turned out, the slowest member of the MAX family to reach the finish line.
segments.tr: El 3 de agosto, la Administración Federal de Aviación emitió un certificado de tipo enmendado para el Boeing 737 MAX 7, el miembro más pequeño y, según resultó ser, el más lento de la familia MAX en llegar a la meta.

segments.src: The jet was supposed to be carrying passengers in 2019.
segments.tr: Se suponía que el avión estaría transportando pasajeros en 2019.

segments.src: It will not carry a paying one until 2027.
segments.tr: No transportará a ninguno de pago hasta 2027.

segments.src: That gap is the story.
segments.tr: Esa brecha es la historia.

segments.src: The MAX 7 is not a new airplane in any meaningful engineering sense; it is a shortened version of a variant that was already certified in 2017.
segments.tr: El MAX 7 no es un avión nuevo en ningún sentido de ingeniería significativo; es una versión acortada de una variante que ya estaba certificada en 2017.

segments.src: And yet it took longer to approve than most clean-sheet designs take to build.
segments.tr: Y, sin embargo, tardó más en aprobarse de lo que tardan en construirse la mayoría de los diseños desde cero.

segments.src: Understanding why is a useful window into how aircraft certification in the United States actually works now — and how much it has changed since the last decade.
segments.tr: Comprender por qué es una ventana útil para ver cómo funciona realmente la certificación de aeronaves en los Estados Unidos ahora, y cuánto ha cambiado desde la última década.

segments.src: ## A short jet with a long timeline
segments.tr: ## Un avión corto con un cronograma largo

segments.src: Boeing launched the MAX program in 2011 and the MAX 8 entered service in May 2017.
segments.tr: Boeing lanzó el programa MAX en 2011 y el MAX 8 entró en servicio en mayo de 2017.

segments.src: The MAX 9 followed.
segments.tr: Le siguió el MAX 9.

segments.src: The MAX 7 — sized for thinner routes and shorter runways, and pitched to Southwest Airlines as the eventual replacement for its aging fleet of 737-700s — first flew in March 2018 and was, at the time, expected to be delivered within a year.
segments.tr: El MAX 7 —dimensionado para rutas con menor densidad y pistas más cortas, y presentado a Southwest Airlines como el reemplazo definitivo de su envejecida flota de 737-700— voló por primera vez en marzo de 2018 y, en ese momento, se esperaba que fuera entregado en el plazo de un año.

segments.src: Then came the two fatal accidents, in October 2018 and March 2019, that claimed 346 lives and led to a worldwide grounding of the MAX fleet for roughly 20 months.
segments.tr: Luego vinieron los dos accidentes fatales, en octubre de 2018 y marzo de 2019, que cobraron 346 vidas y llevaron a la inmovilización mundial de la flota MAX durante aproximadamente 20 meses.

segments.src: The MAX 8 and MAX 9 returned to service in late 2020 after a redesign of the flight-control system.
segments.tr: El MAX 8 y el MAX 9 regresaron al servicio a fines de 2020 tras un rediseño del sistema de control de vuelo.

segments.src: The MAX 7 did not simply resume its old certification track.
segments.tr: El MAX 7 no simplemente reanudó su antigua pista de certificación.

segments.src: It restarted it, under rules that no longer resembled the ones it began under.
segments.tr: La reinició, bajo reglas que ya no se parecía en nada a aquellas bajo las cuales comenzó.

segments.src: ## The three problems that had to be closed
segments.tr: ## Los tres problemas que debían cerrarse

segments.src: According to the certification announcement, the program logged more than 1,000 hours of flight and ground testing in its final phase.
segments.tr: Según el anuncio de certificación, el programa acumuló más de 1000 horas de pruebas de vuelo y en tierra en su fase final.

segments.src: Three technical threads accounted for most of the delay.
segments.tr: Tres hilos técnicos explicaron la mayor parte de la demora.

segments.src: **Flight-control software.** The system at the center of the 2018–2019 accidents, MCAS, was rewritten across the MAX fleet: it now compares both angle-of-attack sensors and stands down if they disagree, activates only once per event, and cannot override pilot input on the control column.
segments.tr: **Flight-control software.** El sistema en el centro de los accidentes de 2018-2019, el MCAS, fue reescrito en toda la flota MAX: ahora compara ambos sensores de ángulo de ataque y se desactiva si no coinciden, se activa solo una vez por evento y no puede anular la entrada del piloto en la columna de control.

segments.src: The MAX 7 inherited that architecture, but inheriting it is not the same as being credited for it.
segments.tr: El MAX 7 heredó esa arquitectura, pero heredarla no es lo mismo que recibir el crédito por ella.

segments.src: Every change had to be re-validated against the specific aerodynamics and weight-and-balance envelope of a shorter fuselage.
segments.tr: Cada cambio tuvo que ser revalidado frente a la aerodinámica específica y el envolvente de peso y centrado de un fuselaje más corto.

segments.src: **Crew alerting.** In December 2020, Congress passed the Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, which required aircraft certified after December 2022 to carry a modern engine-indicating and crew-alerting system — the kind that prioritizes and plainly names a failure rather than lighting several unrelated warnings at once.
segments.tr: **Crew alerting.** En diciembre de 2020, el Congreso aprobó la Ley de Certificación, Seguridad y Rendición de Cuentas de Aeronaves (ACSAA), que exigía que las aeronaves certificadas después de diciembre de 2022 llevaran un sistema moderno de indicación de motores y alerta de la tripulación, el tipo que prioriza y nombra claramente una falla en lugar de encender varias advertencias no relacionadas a la vez.

segments.src: The MAX 7's flight deck is deliberately built to be common with the rest of the 737 fleet, so meeting that requirement outright would have broken the pilot-commonality argument that makes the airplane attractive to airlines in the first place.
segments.tr: La cabina de vuelo del MAX 7 está construida deliberadamente para ser común con el resto de la flota 737, por lo que cumplir con ese requisito de manera directa habría roto el argumento de la comunidad de pilotos que hace que el avión sea atractivo para las aerolíneas en primer lugar.

segments.src: Congress ultimately granted the MAX 7 and MAX 10 relief from the deadline in late 2022, on the condition that Boeing add a set of flight-deck and alerting improvements across the MAX line.
segments.tr: El Congreso finalmente otorgó al MAX 7 y al MAX 10 una exención del plazo a fines de 2022, con la condición de que Boeing agregara un conjunto de mejoras en la cabina de vuelo y de alerta en toda la línea MAX.

segments.src: Those improvements became part of what the FAA had to review.
segments.tr: Esas mejoras pasaron a formar parte de lo que la FAA tuvo que revisar.

segments.src: **Engine anti-ice.** The last and least expected obstacle was a nacelle.
segments.tr: **Engine anti-ice.** El último y menos esperado obstáculo fue una nacela.

segments.src: Engineers determined that if the engine inlet anti-ice system were left running in dry air beyond a certain window, the composite inlet structure could overheat.
segments.tr: Los ingenieros determinaron que si el sistema antihielo de la entrada del motor se dejaba funcionando en aire seco más allá de cierto margen, la estructura compuesta de la entrada podría sobrecalentarse.

segments.src: Boeing asked the FAA in January 2024 for a time-limited exemption while it engineered a permanent fix, then withdrew the request weeks later amid public and congressional criticism that followed a separate in-flight panel failure on an Alaska Airlines MAX 9.
segments.tr: Boeing solicitó a la FAA en enero de 2024 una exención de tiempo limitado mientras diseñaba una solución permanente, y luego retiró la solicitud semanas después en medio de las críticas públicas y del Congreso que siguieron a una falla separada de un panel en vuelo en un MAX 9 de Alaska Airlines.

segments.src: The company committed instead to a hardware redesign.
segments.tr: La compañía se comprometió en su lugar a un rediseño de hardware.

segments.src: That decision was almost certainly correct on the merits, and it cost the program most of two years.
segments.tr: Esa decisión fue casi con certeza correcta en cuanto al fondo, y le costó al programa la mayor parte de dos años.

segments.src: ## The quieter change: who does the certifying
segments.tr: ## El cambio más silencioso: quién realiza la certificación

segments.src: The most consequential shift is the one that does not show up in any single fix.
segments.tr: El cambio más trascendental es el que no aparece en ninguna solución individual.

segments.src: For decades, the FAA delegated large portions of certification work to Boeing employees under an Organization Designation Authorization — a system that let a company find and approve much of its own compliance evidence.
segments.tr: Durante décadas, la FAA delegó grandes porciones del trabajo de certificación en empleados de Boeing bajo una Autorización de Designación de Organización (ODA), un sistema que permitía a una empresa encontrar y aprobar gran parte de su propia evidencia de cumplimiento.

segments.src: The 2020 reform law tightened that arrangement, adding FAA oversight of the delegated engineering unit, stronger protections for employees who raise safety concerns, and a requirement for a formal safety management system.
segments.tr: La ley de reforma de 2020 endureció ese arreglo, agregando la supervisión de la FAA de la unidad de ingeniería delegada, protecciones más fuertes para los empleados que plantean problemas de seguridad y un requisito para un sistema formal de gestión de seguridad.

segments.src: The practical result is that fewer findings are accepted on paper and more are demanded in the air.
segments.tr: El resultado práctico es que se aceptan menos hallazgos en papel y se exigen más en el aire.

segments.src: A thousand test hours for a shortened derivative of an already-certified airframe would have been unusual in 2016.
segments.tr: Mil horas de prueba para un derivado acortado de un fuselaje ya certificado habría sido inusual en 2016.

segments.src: In 2026 it is close to the expected cost of doing business.
segments.tr: En 2026 está cerca del costo esperado de hacer negocios.

segments.src: ## Southwest's thirty parked airplanes
segments.tr: ## Los treinta aviones estacionados de Southwest

segments.src: The commercial arithmetic falls hardest on Southwest Airlines, the MAX 7's launch customer, which has roughly 30 completed aircraft sitting on the ground and will not begin taking deliveries until early 2027.
segments.tr: La aritmética comercial recae con más fuerza en Southwest Airlines, el cliente de lanzamiento del MAX 7, que tiene aproximadamente 30 aviones terminados en tierra y no comenzará a recibir entregas hasta principios de 2027.

segments.src: Those airframes represent capital that has been spent, insured, stored and maintained for years without producing a single block hour of revenue.
segments.tr: Esos fuselajes representan capital que se ha gastado, asegurado, almacenado y mantenido durante años sin producir una sola hora de bloque de ingresos.

segments.src: Southwest's response over the past several years has been to keep flying older 737-700s longer than planned and to convert part of its order book to the larger MAX 8 — a rational hedge that also quietly changed the shape of its network, since a bigger airplane needs more passengers per departure to make sense.
segments.tr: La respuesta de Southwest en los últimos años ha sido seguir volando los 737-700 más antiguos durante más tiempo del planeado y convertir parte de su libro de pedidos al MAX 8 más grande, una cobertura racional que también cambió silenciosamente la forma de su red, ya que un avión más grande necesita más pasajeros por salida para tener sentido.

segments.src: The MAX 7's arrival lets the airline restart a fleet-renewal plan that has been frozen since the end of the last decade, but on a slower clock and with newer, more expensive money.
segments.tr: La llegada del MAX 7 le permite a la aerolínea reiniciar un plan de renovación de flota que ha estado congelado desde el final de la última década, pero en un reloj más lento y con dinero más nuevo y caro.

segments.src: For Boeing, certification converts inventory into cash, which matters for a company that has spent years burning it.
segments.tr: Para Boeing, la certificación convierte el inventario en efectivo, lo que importa para una compañía que ha pasado años quemándolo.

segments.src: But deliveries in early 2027 also mean the revenue arrives against a production system still recovering from post-2024 output limits, and stored aircraft typically need inspection and update work before they can be handed over.
segments.tr: Pero las entregas a principios de 2027 también significan que los ingresos llegan frente a un sistema de producción que aún se está recuperando de los límites de producción posteriores a 2024, y los aviones almacenados típicamente necesitan trabajo de inspección y actualización antes de poder ser entregados.

segments.src: ## What it signals for the MAX 10 — and for everything after
segments.tr: ## Lo que indica para el MAX 10 y para todo lo que venga después

segments.src: The MAX 10, the longest member of the family, is still awaiting approval and faces the same crew-alerting condition and a distinct set of issues of its own, including its extending landing gear.
segments.tr: El MAX 10, el miembro más largo de la familia, aún espera aprobación y enfrenta la misma condición de alerta de la tripulación y un conjunto distinto de problemas propios, incluido su tren de aterrizaje extendido.

segments.src: The MAX 7 outcome is the closest thing to a template available: expect the FAA to close every item rather than accept a deferral, and expect schedule commitments to be treated as forecasts rather than plans.
segments.tr: El resultado del MAX 7 es lo más parecido a una plantilla disponible: espere que la FAA cierre cada elemento en lugar de aceptar un aplazamiento, y espere que los compromisos de cronograma sean tratados como pronósticos en lugar de planes.

segments.src: The wider question is what the right answer looks like.
segments.tr: La pregunta más amplia es cómo se ve la respuesta correcta.

segments.src: Seven years of slippage on a derivative aircraft is not something anyone designed on purpose.
segments.tr: Siete años de retraso en una aeronave derivada no es algo que nadie haya diseñado a propósito.

segments.src: It is the accumulated cost of rebuilding a certification process whose credibility had been damaged, plus one genuine engineering surprise, plus a legislative requirement that arrived mid-program.
segments.tr: Es el costo acumulado de reconstruir un proceso de certificación cuya credibilidad había sido dañada, más una verdadera sorpresa de ingeniería, más un requisito legislativo que llegó a mitad del programa.

segments.src: Reasonable people read the same facts differently: one view is that the system is now working as intended and the delay is the price of not repeating a catastrophic failure; another is that a process this unpredictable discourages manufacturers from building safer new designs at all, because the regulatory timeline cannot be estimated in advance.
segments.tr: Las personas razonables leen los mismos hechos de manera diferente: una opinión es que el sistema ahora está funcionando según lo previsto y la demora es el precio de no repetir una falla catastrófica; otra es que un proceso tan impredecible disuade a los fabricantes de construir nuevos diseños más seguros en absoluto, porque el cronograma regulatorio no se puede estimar de antemano.

segments.src: Both can be true.
segments.tr: Ambas pueden ser verdad.

segments.src: What the MAX 7 demonstrates is that in the United States today, a certificate is issued when the last open item is closed — not when the delivery slot was booked.
segments.tr: Lo que demuestra el MAX 7 es que en el Estados Unidos de hoy, un certificado se emite cuando se cierra el último elemento pendiente, no cuando se reservó el espacio de entrega.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Qué observar a continuación

segments.src: - **Entry into service.** Certification is not the same as flying passengers; route-proving, crew training and the FAA's operational approvals still stand between the certificate and the first ticketed flight.
segments.tr: - **Entry into service.** La certificación no es lo mismo que volar pasajeros; la prueba de rutas, el entrenamiento de la tripulación y las aprobaciones operativas de la FAA aún se interponen entre el certificado y el primer vuelo con boleto.

segments.src: - **Delivery pace through 2027.** How quickly stored airframes can be updated and handed over is a better indicator of Boeing's recovery than the certificate itself.
segments.tr: - **Delivery pace through 2027.** Qué tan rápido se pueden actualizar y entregar los fuselajes almacenados es un mejor indicador de la recuperación de Boeing que el certificado en sí.

segments.src: - **The MAX 10 decision.** Its treatment will show whether the MAX 7 review was a one-off catch-up or the new baseline.
segments.tr: - **The MAX 10 decision.** Su trato mostrará si la revisión del MAX 7 fue una puesta al día única o el nuevo punto de referencia.

segments.src: - **Fleet-wide alerting upgrades.** The improvements attached to the 2022 congressional relief apply beyond one variant, and their rollout is the part of this story that touches airplanes already flying.
segments.tr: - **Fleet-wide alerting upgrades.** Las mejoras adjuntas al alivio del Congreso de 2022 se aplican más allá de una variante, y su despliegue es la parte de esta historia que toca a los aviones que ya están volando.

segments.tr: هذه الفجوة هي جوهر القصة.

segments.src: The MAX 7 is not a new airplane in any meaningful engineering sense; it is a shortened version of a variant that was already certified in 2017.
segments.tr: طائرة ماكس 7 ليست طائرة جديدة بأي مفهوم هندسي حقيقي؛ بل هي نسخة أقصر من طراز تم اعتماده مسبقاً في عام 2017.

segments.src: And yet it took longer to approve than most clean-sheet designs take to build.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، استغرق اعتمادها وقتاً أطول مما تستغرقه معظم التصاميم الجديدة كلياً في البناء.

segments.src: Understanding why is a useful window into how aircraft certification in the United States actually works now — and how much it has changed since the last decade.
segments.tr: إن فهم السبب يمثل نافذة مفيدة حول كيفية عمل عملية اعتماد الطائرات في الولايات المتحدة حالياً - ومدى تغيرها منذ العقد الماضي.

segments.src: ## A short jet with a long timeline
segments.tr: ## طائرة قصيرة بجدول زمني طويل

segments.src: Boeing launched the MAX program in 2011 and the MAX 8 entered service in May 2017.
segments.tr: أطلقت بوينغ برنامج ماكس في عام 2011 ودخلت ماكس 8 الخدمة في مايو/أيار 2017.

segments.src: The MAX 9 followed.
segments.tr: وتبعته طائرة ماكس 9.

segments.src: The MAX 7 — sized for thinner routes and shorter runways, and pitched to Southwest Airlines as the eventual replacement for its aging fleet of 737-700s — first flew in March 2018 and was, at the time, expected to be delivered within a year.
segments.tr: أما طائرة ماكس 7 - المصممة للخطوط الأقل ازدحاماً والمدرجات القصيرة، والتي تم تسويقها لشركة خطوط ساوث وست الجوية كبديل نهائي لأسطولها القديم من طراز 737-700 - فقد قامت بأول رحلة لها في مارس/آذار 2018 وكان متوقعاً في ذلك الوقت أن يتم تسليمها في غضون عام.

segments.src: Then came the two fatal accidents, in October 2018 and March 2019, that claimed 346 lives and led to a worldwide grounding of the MAX fleet for roughly 20 months.
segments.tr: ثم جاء الحادثان المأساويان، في أكتوبر/تشرين الأول 2018 ومارس/آذار 2019، اللذان أوديا بحياة 346 شخصاً وأديا إلى وقف تشغيل أسطول ماكس عالمياً لمدة 20 شهراً تقريباً.

segments.src: The MAX 8 and MAX 9 returned to service in late 2020 after a redesign of the flight-control system.
segments.tr: عاد طرازاً ماكس 8 وماكس 9 إلى الخدمة في أواخر عام 2020 بعد إعادة تصميم نظام التحكم في الطيران.

segments.src: The MAX 7 did not simply resume its old certification track.
segments.tr: لكن طائرة ماكس 7 لم تستأنف مسار اعتمادها القديم ببساطة.

segments.src: It restarted it, under rules that no longer resembled the ones it began under.
segments.tr: بل أعادت تشغيله من جديد، بموجب قواعد لم تعد تشبه تلك التي بدأت في ظل ها.
