segments.src: ## The three problems that had to be closed
segments.tr: ## المشكلات الثلاث التي كان لا بد من إغلاق ملفها

segments.src: According to the certification announcement, the program logged more than 1,000 hours of flight and ground testing in its final phase.
segments.tr: وفقاً لإعلان الاعتماد، سجل البرنامج أكثر من 1,000 ساعة من اختبارات الطيران والأرض في مرحلته النهائية.

segments.src: Three technical threads accounted for most of the delay.
segments.tr: وكانت هناك ثلاثة مواضيع تقنية مسؤولة عن غالبية التأخير.

segments.src: **Flight-control software.** The system at the center of the 2018–2019 accidents, MCAS, was rewritten across the MAX fleet: it now compares both angle-of-attack sensors and stands down if they disagree, activates only once per event, and cannot override pilot input on the control column.
segments.tr: **برمجيات التحكم في الطيران.** تم إعادة كتابة النظام الذي كان في مركز حادثي 2018-2019 (MCAS) عبر أسطول ماكس بأكمله: فهو يقارن الآن بين مستشعري زاوية الهجوم ويتوقف عن العمل إذا اختلفا، وينشط مرة واحدة فقط لكل حدث، ولا يمكنه تجاوز مدخلات الطيار على عمود التحكم.

segments.src: The MAX 7 inherited that architecture, but inheriting it is not the same as being credited for it.
segments.tr: ورثت طائرة ماكس 7 هذه البنية، لكن وراثة البنية لا تعني بالضرورة الاعتماد التلقائي لها.

segments.src: Every change had to be re-validated against the specific aerodynamics and weight-and-balance envelope of a shorter fuselage.
segments.tr: كان لزاماً إعادة التحقق من كل تغيير في مواجهة الديناميكا الهوائية المحددة ونطاق الوزن والاتزان لجسم الطائرة الأقصر.

segments.src: **Crew alerting.** In December 2020, Congress passed the Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, which required aircraft certified after December 2022 to carry a modern engine-indicating and crew-alerting system — the kind that prioritizes and plainly names a failure rather than lighting several unrelated warnings at once.
segments.tr: **تنبيه الطاقم.** في ديسمبر/كانون الأول 2020، أقر الكونغرس قانون اعتماد الطائرات والسلامة والمساءلة، والذي فرض على الطائرات التي يتم اعتمادها بعد ديسمبر/كانون الأول 2022 أن تحمل نظاماً حديثاً للإشارة إلى محركات الطائرة وتنبيه الطاقم - وهو النظام الذي يحدد ويسمي بوضوح أي عطل بدلاً من إضاءة عدة تحذيرات غير ذات صلة دفعة واحدة.

segments.src: The MAX 7's flight deck is deliberately built to be common with the rest of the 737 fleet, so meeting that requirement outright would have broken the pilot-commonality argument that makes the airplane attractive to airlines in the first place.
segments.tr: تم تصميم قمرة القيادة في ماكس 7 عمداً لتكون متطابقة مع بقية أسطول 737، لذا فإن تلبية هذا المتطلب بشكل مباشر كان سيقوض حجة التوافق بين الطيارين والتي تجعل الطائرة جذابة لشركات الطيران في المقام الأول.

segments.src: Congress ultimately granted the MAX 7 and MAX 10 relief from the deadline in late 2022, on the condition that Boeing add a set of flight-deck and alerting improvements across the MAX line.
segments.tr: منح الكونغرس في نهاية المطاف طائرتي ماكس 7 وماكس 10 إعفاءً من الموعد النهائي في أواخر عام 2022، بشرط أن تضيف بوينغ مجموعة من تحسينات قمرة القيادة والتنبيه عبر خط طائرات ماكس.

segments.src: Those improvements became part of what the FAA had to review.
segments.tr: وأصبحت تلك التحسينات جزءاً مما كان على إدارة الطيران الفيدرالية مراجعته.

segments.src: **Engine anti-ice.** The last and least expected obstacle was a nacelle.
segments.tr: **مضاد الجليد للمحرك.** كانت العقبة الأخيرة والأقل توقعاً تتمثل في غلاف المحرك.

segments.src: Engineers determined that if the engine inlet anti-ice system were left running in dry air beyond a certain window, the composite inlet structure could overheat.
segments.tr: خلص المهندسون إلى أنه إذا ترك نظام مضاد الجليد لمدخل المحرك يعمل في الهواء الجاف لفترة تتجاوز حداً معيناً، فقد يتعرض هيكل المدخل المصنوع من المواد المركبة للسخونة المفرطة.

segments.src: Boeing asked the FAA in January 2024 for a time-limited exemption while it engineered a permanent fix, then withdrew the request weeks later amid public and congressional criticism that followed a separate in-flight panel failure on an Alaska Airlines MAX 9.
segments.tr: طلبت بوينغ من إدارة الطيران الفيدرالية في يناير/كانون الثاني 2024 إعفاءً محدد المدة ريثما تقوم هندسة حل دائم، ثم سحب الطلب بعد أسابيع وسط انتقادات عامة وبرلمانية أعقبت حادثاً منفصلاً لفشل لوحة في الجو على متن طائرة ماكس 9 تابعة لخطوط ألاسكا الجوية.

segments.src: The company committed instead to a hardware redesign.
segments.tr: التزمت الشركة بدلاً من ذلك بإعادة تصميم الأجهزة.

segments.src: That decision was almost certainly correct on the merits, and it cost the program most of two years.
segments.tr: وكان هذا القرار صحيحاً على الأرجح من الناحية الموضوعية، وقد كلف البرنامج معظم عامين.

segments.src: ## The quieter change: who does the certifying
segments.tr: ## التغيير الأهدأ: من الذي يقوم بالاعتماد

segments.src: The most consequential shift is the one that does not show up in any single fix.
segments.tr: التغيير الأكثر تأثيراً هو ذلك الذي لا يظهر في أي إصلاح فردي.

segments.src: For decades, the FAA delegated large portions of certification work to Boeing employees under an Organization Designation Authorization — a system that let a company find and approve much of its own compliance evidence.
segments.tr: لعقود طويلة، فوضت إدارة الطيران الفيدرالية أجزاء كبيرة من أعمال الاعتماد لموظفي بوينغ بموجب تفويض تصميم المؤسسة - وهو نظام يسمح للشركة بإيجاد واعتماد جزء كبير من أدلة الامتثال الخاصة بها.

segments.src: The 2020 reform law tightened that arrangement, adding FAA oversight of the delegated engineering unit, stronger protections for employees who raise safety concerns, and a requirement for a formal safety management system.
segments.tr: أدى قانون الإصلاح لعام 2020 إلى تشديد هذا الترتيب، مضيفاً رقابة إدارة الطيران الفيدرالية على وحدة الهندسة المفوضة، وحماية أقوى للموظفين الذين يثيرون مخاوف تتعلق بالسلامة، ومتطلبات لنظام إدارة سلامة رسمي.

segments.src: The practical result is that fewer findings are accepted on paper and more are demanded in the air.
segments.tr: النتيجة العملية هي قبول عدد أقل من النتائج على الورق والمطالبة بالمزيد في الجو.

segments.src: A thousand test hours for a shortened derivative of an already-certified airframe would have been unusual in 2016.
segments.tr: ألف ساعة اختبار لنسخة مطورة ومختصرة من هيكل طائرة معتمد مسبقاً كانت ستُعد أمراً غير معتاد في عام 2016.

segments.src: In 2026 it is close to the expected cost of doing business.
segments.tr: أما في عام 2026 فهي تقترب من التكلفة المتوقعة لممارسة الأعمال التجارية.

segments.src: ## Southwest's thirty parked airplanes
segments.tr: ## طائرات ساوث وست الثلاثون المركونة

segments.src: The commercial arithmetic falls hardest on Southwest Airlines, the MAX 7's launch customer, which has roughly 30 completed aircraft sitting on the ground and will not begin taking deliveries until early 2027.
segments.tr: الحسابات التجارية تقع بثقلها الأكبر على عاتق خطوط ساوث وست الجوية، العميل الإطلاق لماكس 7، والتي لداتها ما يقرب من 30 طائرة مكتملة متوقفة على الأرض ولن تبدأ في تسلم الطائرات حتى أوائل عام 2027.

segments.src: Those airframes represent capital that has been spent, insured, stored and maintained for years without producing a single block hour of revenue.
segments.tr: تمثل هياكل الطائرات هذه رأسمالاً تم إنفاقه وتأمينه وتخزينه وصيانته لسنوات دون تحقيق ساعة تشغيل واحدة من الإيرادات.

segments.src: Southwest's response over the past several years has been to keep flying older 737-700s longer than planned and to convert part of its order book to the larger MAX 8 — a rational hedge that also quietly changed the shape of its network, since a bigger airplane needs more passengers per departure to make sense.
segments.tr: كان رد فعل ساوث وست على مدى السنوات العديدة الماضية هو الاستمرار في تشغيل طائرات 737-700 الأقدم لفترة أطول من المخطط وتحويل جزء من دفتر طلبياتها إلى طائرة ماكس 8 الأكبر - وهي خطوة تحوط عقلانية غيرت بهدوء شكل شبكتها أيضاً، نظراً لأن الطائرة الأكبر تحتاج إلى عدد أكبر من الركاب لكل رحلة مغادرة لكي تصبح مجدية اقتصادياً.

segments.src: The MAX 7's arrival lets the airline restart a fleet-renewal plan that has been frozen since the end of the last decade, but on a slower clock and with newer, more expensive money.
segments.tr: يتيح وصول ماكس 7 لشركة الطيران استئناف خطة تجديد الأسطول المجمدة منذ نهاية العقد الماضي، ولكن بوتيرة أبطأ وبأموال أحدث وأكثر تكلفة.

segments.src: For Boeing, certification converts inventory into cash, which matters for a company that has spent years burning it.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لبوينغ، يحول الاعتماد المخزون إلى نقد، وهو أمر مهم لشركة قضت سنوات في حرق السيولة.

segments.src: But deliveries in early 2027 also mean the revenue arrives against a production system still recovering from post-2024 output limits, and stored aircraft typically need inspection and update work before they can be handed over.
segments.tr: لكن عمليات التسليم في أوائل عام 2027 تعني أيضاً أن الإيرادات تصل في مواجهة نظام إنتاج لا يزال يتعافى من حدود الإنتاج التي تلت عام 2024، وغالباً ما تحتاج الطائرات المخزنة إلى أعمال تفتيش وتحديث قبل تسليمها.

segments.src: ## What it signals for the MAX 10 — and for everything after
segments.tr: ## ما يعنيه ذلك بالنسبة لماكس 10 - ولكل ما سيأتي بعده

segments.src: The MAX 10, the longest member of the family, is still awaiting approval and faces the same crew-alerting condition and a distinct set of issues of its own, including its extending landing gear.
segments.tr: طائرة ماكس 10، وهي العضو الأطول في العائلة، لا تزال تنتظر الموافقة وتواجه نفس شرط تنبيه الطاقم ومجموعة فريدة من مشكلاتها الخاصة، بما في ذلك معدات الهبوط الممتدة.

segments.src: The MAX 7 outcome is the closest thing to a template available: expect the FAA to close every item rather than accept a deferral, and expect schedule commitments to be treated as forecasts rather than plans.
segments.tr: نتيجة ماكس 7 هي أقرب شيء إلى نموذج متاح: توقع أن تقوم إدارة الطيران الفيدرالية بإغلاق كل بند بدلاً من قبول التأجيل، وتوقع أن يتم التعامل مع التزامات الجدول الزمني كتقديرات مستقبلية وليست خططاً مؤكدة.

segments.src: The wider question is what the right answer looks like.
segments.tr: السؤال الأوسع هو شكل الإجابة الصحيحة.

segments.src: Seven years of slippage on a derivative aircraft is not something anyone designed on purpose.
segments.tr: سبع سنوات من التأخير في طائرة مشتقة ليست شيئاً صممه أحد عن قصد.

segments.src: It is the accumulated cost of rebuilding a certification process whose credibility had been damaged, plus one genuine engineering surprise, plus a legislative requirement that arrived mid-program.
segments.tr: إنه التكلفة المتراكمة لإعادة بناء عملية اعتماد تضرر مصداقيتها، بالإضافة إلى مفاجأة هندسية حقيقية، وطلب تشريعي وصل في منتصف البرنامج.

segments.src: Reasonable people read the same facts differently: one view is that the system is now working as intended and the delay is the price of not repeating a catastrophic failure; another is that a process this unpredictable discourages manufacturers from building safer new designs at all, because the regulatory timeline cannot be estimated in advance.
segments.tr: الأشخاص العقلاء يقرأون الحقائق نفسها بشكل مختلف: وجهة نظر تقول إن النظام يعمل الآن على النحو المنشود وأن التأخير هو ثمن عدم تكرار فشل كارثي؛ والأخرى ترى أن عملية بهذا القدر من عدم القدرة على التنبؤ تثبط عزيمة الشركات المصنعة عن بناء تصميمات جديدة وأكثر أماناً من الأساس، لتعذر تقدير الجدول الزمني التنظيمي مقدماً.

segments.src: Both can be true.
segments.tr: كلا الأمرين قد يكون صحيحاً.

segments.src: What the MAX 7 demonstrates is that in the United States today, a certificate is issued when the last open item is closed — not when the delivery slot was booked.
segments.tr: ما تثبته طائرة ماكس 7 هو أنه في الولايات المتحدة اليوم، يتم إصدار الشهادة عندما يتم إغلاق آخر بند مفتوح - وليس عندما يتم حجز خانة التسليم.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته بعد ذلك

segments.src: - **Entry into service.** Certification is not the same as flying passengers; route-proving, crew training and the FAA's operational approvals still stand between the certificate and the first ticketed flight.
segments.tr: - **الدخول إلى الخدمة.** الاعتماد ليس هو نفسه الطيران بالركاب؛ فالإثبات الميداني للخطوط، وتدريب الطاقم، والموافقات التشغيلية لإدارة الطيران الفيدرالية ما زالت تقف بين الشهادة والرحلة الأولى التي تحمل تذاكر.

segments.src: - **Delivery pace through 2027.** How quickly stored airframes can be updated and handed over is a better indicator of Boeing's recovery than the certificate itself.
segments.tr: - **وتيرة التسليم حتى عام 2027.** مدى سرعة تحديث هياكل الطائرات المخزنة وتسليمها هو مؤشر أفضل على تعافي بوينغ من الشهادة نفسها.

segments.src: - **The MAX 10 decision.** Its treatment will show whether the MAX 7 review was a one-off catch-up or the new baseline.
segments.tr: - **قرار ماكس 10.** ستظهر طريقة التعامل معها ما إذا كانت مراجعة ماكس 7 حالة استثنائية للحاق بالركب أم هي المعيار الأساسي الجديد.

segments.src: - **Fleet-wide alerting upgrades.** The improvements attached to the 2022 congressional relief apply beyond one variant, and their rollout is the part of this story that touches airplanes already flying.
segments.tr: - **ترقيات التنبيه على مستوى الأسطول.** التحسينات المرتبطة بإعفاء الكونغرس لعام 2022 تنطبق على ما هو أبعد من طراز واحد، ونشرها هو الجزء من هذه القصة الذي يمس الطائرات المحلقة بالفعل.

segments.src: *This article is general news analysis based on publicly reported information as of August 5, 2026.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة هي تحليل إخباري عام يعتمد على معلومات مُبلغ عنها علناً اعتباراً من 5 أغسطس 2026.

segments.src: Certification and delivery schedules are set by the FAA, Boeing and individual airlines and can change; readers should consult official announcements from those organizations for operational details.*
segments.tr: يتم تحديد جداول الاعتماد والتسليم من قبل إدارة الطيران الفيدرالية، وبوينغ، وشركات الطيران الفردية ويمكن أن تتغير؛ ويجب على القراء الرجوع إلى الإعلانات الرسمية من تلك المنظمات للحصول على التفاصيل التشغيلية.*

fr.title: Sept ans de retard : ce que l'approbation du 737 MAX 7 par la FAA révèle sur la façon dont l'Amérique certifie les avions

segments.src: On August 3, the Federal Aviation Administration issued an amended type certificate for the Boeing 737 MAX 7 — the smallest and, as it turned out, the slowest member of the MAX family to reach the finish line.
segments.tr: Le 3 août, la Federal Aviation Administration a délivré un certificat de type modifié pour le Boeing 737 MAX 7 — le membre le plus petit et, s'est-il avéré, le plus lent de la famille MAX à atteindre la ligne d'arrivée.

segments.src: The jet was supposed to be carrying passengers in 2019.
segments.tr: L'avion était censé transporter des passagers en 2019.

segments.src: It will not carry a paying one until 2027.
segments.tr: Il n'en transportera pas un seul payant avant 2027.

segments.src: That gap is the story.
segments.tr: Cet écart est toute l'histoire.

segments.src: The MAX 7 is not a new airplane in any meaningful engineering sense; it is a shortened version of a variant that was already certified in 2017.
segments.tr: Le MAX 7 n'est pas un nouvel avion au sens technique du terme ; c'est une version raccourcie d'une variante déjà certifiée en 2017.

segments.src: And yet it took longer to approve than most clean-sheet designs take to build.
segments.tr: Et pourtant, son approbation a pris plus de temps que la construction de la plupart des conceptions entièrement nouvelles.

segments.src: Understanding why is a useful window into how aircraft certification in the United States actually works now — and how much it has changed since the last decade.
segments.tr: Comprendre pourquoi offre une perspective utile sur la manière dont la certification des aéronefs aux États-Unis fonctionne réellement aujourd'hui — et à quel point elle a changé depuis la décennie précédente.

segments.src: ## A short jet with a long timeline
segments.tr: ## Un avion court au calendrier long

segments.src: Boeing launched the MAX program in 2011 and the MAX 8 entered service in May 2017.
segments.tr: Boeing a lancé le programme MAX en 2011 et le MAX 8 est entré en service en mai 2017.

segments.src: The MAX 9 followed.
segments.tr: Le MAX 9 a suivi.

segments.src: The MAX 7 — sized for thinner routes and shorter runways, and pitched to Southwest Airlines as the eventual replacement for its aging fleet of 737-700s — first flew in March 2018 and was, at the time, expected to be delivered within a year.
segments.tr: Le MAX 7 — dimensionné pour des lignes moins fréquentées et des pistes plus courtes, et présenté à Southwest Airlines comme le remplaçant éventuel de sa flotte vieillissante de 737-700 — a effectué son premier vol en mars 2018 et devait alors être livré dans l'année.

segments.src: Then came the two fatal accidents, in October 2018 and March 2019, that claimed 346 lives and led to a worldwide grounding of the MAX fleet for roughly 20 months.
segments.tr: Sont ensuite survenus les deux accidents mortels, en octobre 2018 et mars 2019, qui ont fait 346 victimes et entraîné l'immobilisation au sol de la flotte MAX dans le monde entier pendant environ 20 mois.

segments.src: The MAX 8 and MAX 9 returned to service in late 2020 after a redesign of the flight-control system.
segments.tr: Le MAX 8 et le MAX 9 ont repris du service fin 2020 après une refonte du système de commande de vol.

segments.src: The MAX 7 did not simply resume its old certification track.
segments.tr: Le MAX 7 n'a pas simplement repris son ancienne trajectoire de certification.

segments.src: It restarted it, under rules that no longer resembled the ones it began under.
segments.tr: Il l'a redémarrée, sous des règles qui ne ressemblaient plus à celles qui prévalaient à ses débuts.

segments.src: ## The three problems that had to be closed
segments.tr: ## Les trois problèmes qui devaient être résolus

segments.src: According to the certification announcement, the program logged more than 1,000 hours of flight and ground testing in its final phase.
segments.tr: Selon l'annonce de certification, le programme a enregistré plus de 1 000 heures d'essais en vol et au sol lors de sa phase finale.

segments.src: Three technical threads accounted for most of the delay.
segments.tr: Trois volets techniques expliquent l'essentiel du retard.

segments.src: **Flight-control software.** The system at the center of the 2018–2019 accidents, MCAS, was rewritten across the MAX fleet: it now compares both angle-of-attack sensors and stands down if they disagree, activates only once per event, and cannot override pilot input on the control column.
segments.tr: **Logiciel de commande de vol.** Le système au cœur des accidents de 2018-2019, le MCAS, a été réécrit pour l'ensemble de la flotte MAX : il compare désormais les deux capteurs d'angle d'attaque et se désactive en cas de désaccord, s'active une seule fois par événement et ne peut pas contourner l'action du pilote sur le manche.

segments.src: The MAX 7 inherited that architecture, but inheriting it is not the same as being credited for it.
segments.tr: Le MAX 7 a hérité de cette architecture, mais en hériter ne signifie pas qu'on lui en accorde automatiquement le bénéfice.

segments.src: Every change had to be re-validated against the specific aerodynamics and weight-and-balance envelope of a shorter fuselage.
segments.tr: Chaque modification a dû être revalidee au regard de l'aérodynamique spécifique et de l'enveloppe de centrage et de poids d'un fuselage plus court.

segments.src: **Crew alerting.** In December 2020, Congress passed the Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, which required aircraft certified after December 2022 to carry a modern engine-indicating and crew-alerting system — the kind that prioritizes and plainly names a failure rather than lighting several unrelated warnings at once.
segments.tr: **Alerte de l'équipage.** En décembre 2020, le Congrès a voté l'Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, qui exigeait que les aéronefs certifiés après décembre 2022 soient dotés d'un système moderne d'indication des moteurs et d'alerte de l'équipage — un système qui hiérarchise et nomme clairement une panne plutôt que d'allumer plusieurs avertissements sans lien entre eux en même temps.

segments.src: The MAX 7's flight deck is deliberately built to be common with the rest of the 737 fleet, so meeting that requirement outright would have broken the pilot-commonality argument that makes the airplane attractive to airlines in the first place.
segments.tr: Le cockpit du MAX 7 est délibérément conçu pour être commun avec le reste de la flotte 737, de sorte que satisfaire pleinement à cette exigence aurait brisé l'argument de la comunauté des pilotes qui rend l'avion attrayant pour les compagnies aériennes au départ.

segments.src: Congress ultimately granted the MAX 7 and MAX 10 relief from the deadline in late 2022, on the condition that Boeing add a set of flight-deck and alerting improvements across the MAX line.
segments.tr: Le Congrès a finalement accordé au MAX 7 et au MAX 10 une dérogation à cette échéance fin 2022, à la condition que Boeing ajoute un ensemble d'améliorations du cockpit et des alertes sur toute la gamme MAX.

segments.src: Those improvements became part of what the FAA had to review.
segments.tr: Ces améliorations sont devenues une partie de ce que la FAA devait examiner.

segments.src: **Engine anti-ice.** The last and least expected obstacle was a nacelle.
segments.tr: **Anti-givrage des moteurs.** Le dernier obstacle, et le moins attendu, fut une nacelle.

segments.src: Engineers determined that if the engine inlet anti-ice system were left running in dry air beyond a certain window, the composite inlet structure could overheat.
segments.tr: Les ingénieurs ont déterminé que si le système anti-givrage de l'entrée d'air du moteur restait en marche dans de l'air sec au-delà d'une certaine durée, la structure composite de l'entrée d'air pouvait surchauffer.

segments.src: Boeing asked the FAA in January 2024 for a time-limited exemption while it engineered a permanent fix, then withdrew the request weeks later amid public and congressional criticism that followed a separate in-flight panel failure on an Alaska Airlines MAX 9.
segments.tr: Boeing a demandé à la FAA en janvier 2024 une exemption temporaire le temps de concevoir une correction permanente, puis a retiré sa demande quelques semaines plus tard au milieu des critiques du public et du Congrès qui ont suivi la défaillance distincte d'un panneau en vol sur un MAX 9 d'Alaska Airlines.

segments.src: The company committed instead to a hardware redesign.
segments.tr: L'entreprise s'est plutôt engagée sur une refonte matérielle.

segments.src: That decision was almost certainly correct on the merits, and it cost the program most of two years.
segments.tr: Cette décision était presque certainement la bonne sur le fond, et elle a coûté au programme près de deux ans.

segments.src: ## The quieter change: who does the certifying
segments.tr: ## Le changement plus discret : qui effectue la certification

segments.src: The most consequential shift is the one that does not show up in any single fix.
segments.tr: Le changement le plus lourd de conséquences est celui qui n'apparaît dans aucune correction isolée.

segments.src: For decades, the FAA delegated large portions of certification work to Boeing employees under an Organization Designation Authorization — a system that let a company find and approve much of its own compliance evidence.
segments.tr: Pendant des décennies, la FAA a délégué une grande partie du travail de certification à des employés de Boeing dans le cadre d'une Organization Designation Authorization — un système qui permettait à une entreprise de trouver et d'approuver une grande partie de ses propres preuves de conformité.

segments.src: The 2020 reform law tightened that arrangement, adding FAA oversight of the delegated engineering unit, stronger protections for employees who raise safety concerns, and a requirement for a formal safety management system.
segments.tr: La loi de réforme de 2020 a durci cet arrangement, en ajoutant une supervision de la FAA sur l'unité d'ingénierie déléguée, une protection renforcée pour les employés signalant des problèmes de sécurité et l'obligation de mettre en place un système formel de gestion de la sécurité.

segments.src: The practical result is that fewer findings are accepted on paper and more are demanded in the air.
segments.tr: Le résultat pratique est que moins de constats sont acceptés sur papier et davantage sont exigés en vol.

segments.src: A thousand test hours for a shortened derivative of an already-certified airframe would have been unusual in 2016.
segments.tr: Un millier d'heures d'essais pour une version dérivée et raccourcie d'une cellule déjà certifiée aurait été inhabituel en 2016.

segments.src: In 2026 it is close to the expected cost of doing business.
segments.tr: En 2026, cela s'approche du coût normal des affaires.

segments.src: ## Southwest's thirty parked airplanes
segments.tr: ## Les trente avions parqués de Southwest

segments.src: The commercial arithmetic falls hardest on Southwest Airlines, the MAX 7's launch customer, which has roughly 30 completed aircraft sitting on the ground and will not begin taking deliveries until early 2027.
segments.tr: L'arithmétique commerciale pèse le plus lourdement sur Southwest Airlines, le client de lancement du MAX 7, qui compte environ 30 appareils achevés cloués au sol et ne commencera à prendre livraison qu'au début de 2027.

segments.src: Those airframes represent capital that has been spent, insured, stored and maintained for years without producing a single block hour of revenue.
segments.tr: Ces cellules représentent un capital qui a été dépensé, assuré, stocké et entretenu pendant des années sans produire une seule heure de bloc de revenus.

segments.src: Southwest's response over the past several years has been to keep flying older 737-700s longer than planned and to convert part of its order book to the larger MAX 8 — a rational hedge that also quietly changed the shape of its network, since a bigger airplane needs more passengers per departure to make sense.
segments.tr: La réponse de Southwest au cours des dernières années a consisté à continuer de faire voler des 737-700 plus anciens plus longtemps que prévu et à convertir une partie de son carnet de commandes vers le MAX 8, plus grand — une couverture rationnelle qui a également modifié discrètement la forme de son réseau, puisqu'un avion plus grand a besoin de plus de passagers par vol pour être rentable.

segments.src: The MAX 7's arrival lets the airline restart a fleet-renewal plan that has been frozen since the end of the last decade, but on a slower clock and with newer, more expensive money.
segments.tr: L'arrivée du MAX 7 permet à la compagnie aérienne de relancer un plan de renouvellement de flotte qui était gelé depuis la fin de la décennie précédente, mais sur un rythme plus lent et avec de l'argent plus récent et plus cher.

segments.src: For Boeing, certification converts inventory into cash, which matters for a company that has spent years burning it.
segments.tr: Pour Boeing, la certification convertit les stocks en liquidités, ce qui compte pour une entreprise qui a passé des années à en brûler.

segments.src: But deliveries in early 2027 also mean the revenue arrives against a production system still recovering from post-2024 output limits, and stored aircraft typically need inspection and update work before they can be handed over.
segments.tr: Mais des livraisons au début de 2027 signifient également que les revenus arrivent face à un système de production qui se remet encore des limites de production d'après 2024, et les avions stockés nécessitent généralement des travaux d'inspection et de mise à jour avant de pouvoir être remis.

segments.src: ## What it signals for the MAX 10 — and for everything after
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela annonce pour le MAX 10 — et pour tout le reste

segments.src: The MAX 10, the longest member of the family, is still awaiting approval and faces the same crew-alerting condition and a distinct set of issues of its own, including its extending landing gear.
segments.tr: Le MAX 10, le plus grand membre de la famille, attend toujours son approbation et fait face à la même condition d'alerte de l'équipage ainsi qu'à son propre ensemble de problèmes distincts, y compris son train d'atterrissage extensible.

segments.src: The MAX 7 outcome is the closest thing to a template available: expect the FAA to close every item rather than accept a deferral, and expect schedule commitments to be treated as forecasts rather than plans.
segments.tr: Le résultat du MAX 7 est ce qui se rapproche le plus d'un modèle : attendez-vous à ce que la FAA clôture chaque point plutôt que d'accepter un report, et à ce que les engagements de calendrier soient traités comme des prévisions plutôt que comme des plans.

segments.src: The wider question is what the right answer looks like.
segments.tr: La question plus large est de savoir à quoi ressemble la bonne réponse.

segments.src: Seven years of slippage on a derivative aircraft is not something anyone designed on purpose.
segments.tr: Sept ans de glissement sur un aéronef dérivé ne sont pas quelque chose que quiconque a conçu sciemment.

segments.src: It is the accumulated cost of rebuilding a certification process whose credibility had been damaged, plus one genuine engineering surprise, plus a legislative requirement that arrived mid-program.
segments.tr: C'est le coût accumulé de la reconstruction d'un processus de certification dont la crédibilité avait été endommagée, plus une véritable surprise d'ingénierie, plus une exigence législative arrivée en milieu de programme.

segments.src: Reasonable people read the same facts differently: one view is that the system is now working as intended and the delay is the price of not repeating a catastrophic failure; another is that a process this unpredictable discourages manufacturers from building safer new designs at all, because the regulatory timeline cannot be estimated in advance.
segments.tr: Des personnes raisonnables lisent les mêmes faits différemment : d'un côté, le système fonctionne désormais comme prévu et le retard est le prix à payer pour ne pas répéter un échec catastrophique ; de l'autre, un processus aussi imprévisible décourage totalement les fabricants de construire de nouvelles conceptions plus sûres, car le calendrier réglementaire ne peut être estimé à l'avance.

segments.src: Both can be true.
segments.tr: Les deux peuvent être vrais.

segments.src: What the MAX 7 demonstrates is that in the United States today, a certificate is issued when the last open item is closed — not when the delivery slot was booked.
segments.tr: Ce que démontre le MAX 7, c'est qu'aux États-Unis aujourd'hui, un certificat est délivré lorsque le dernier point ouvert est clos — et non lorsque le créneau de livraison a été réservé.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller ensuite

segments.src: - **Entry into service.** Certification is not the same as flying passengers; route-proving, crew training and the FAA's operational approvals still stand between the certificate and the first ticketed flight.
segments.tr: - **Entrée en service.** La certification ne s'apparente pas au transport de passagers ; la validation des itinéraires, la formation des équipages et les approbations opérationnelles de la FAA se dressent encore entre le certificat et le premier vol payant.

segments.src: - **Delivery pace through 2027.** How quickly stored airframes can be updated and handed over is a better indicator of Boeing's recovery than the certificate itself.
segments.tr: - **Cadence des livraisons jusqu'en 2027.** La rapidité avec laquelle les cellules stockées peuvent être mises à jour et remises est un meilleur indicateur de la reprise de Boeing que le certificat lui-même.

segments.src: - **The MAX 10 decision.** Its treatment will show whether the MAX 7 review was a one-off catch-up or the new baseline.
segments.tr: - **La décision concernant le MAX 10.** Son traitement montrera si l'examen du MAX 7 était un rattrapage ponctuel ou la nouvelle référence de base.

segments.src: - **Fleet-wide alerting upgrades.** The improvements attached to the 2022 congressional relief apply beyond one variant, and their rollout is the part of this story that touches airplanes already flying.
segments.tr: - **Mises à niveau des alertes à l'échelle de la flotte.** Les améliorations liées à l'aide du Congrès de 2022 s'appliquent au-delà d'une seule variante, et leur déploiement est la partie de cette histoire qui touche des avions déjà en vol.

segments.tr: A empresa comprometeu-se em vez disso com um redesenho de hardware.

segments.src: That decision was almost certainly correct on the merits, and it cost the program most of two years.
segments.tr: Essa decisão foi quase certamente correta em seu mérito, e custou ao programa a maior parte de dois anos.

segments.src: ## The quieter change: who does the certifying
segments.tr: ## A mudança mais silenciosa: quem faz a certificação

segments.src: The most consequential shift is the one that does not show up in any single fix.
segments.tr: A mudança mais consequente é aquela que não aparece em nenhuma correção isolada.

segments.src: For decades, the FAA delegated large portions of certification work to Boeing employees under an Organization Designation Authorization — a system that let a company find and approve much of its own compliance evidence.
segments.tr: Durante décadas, a FAA delegou grandes partes do trabalho de certificação a funcionários da Boeing sob uma Autorização de Designação de Organização — um sistema que permitia a uma empresa encontrar e aprovar grande parte de suas próprias evidências de conformidade.

segments.src: The 2020 reform law tightened that arrangement, adding FAA oversight of the delegated engineering unit, stronger protections for employees who raise safety concerns, and a requirement for a formal safety management system.
segments.tr: A lei de reforma de 2020 endureceu esse arranjo, adicionando supervisão da FAA sobre a unidade de engenharia delegada, proteções mais fortes para funcionários que levantam preocupações de segurança e um requisito para um sistema formal de gerenciamento de segurança.

segments.src: The practical result is that fewer findings are accepted on paper and more are demanded in the air.
segments.tr: O resultado prático é que menos conclusões são aceitas no papel e mais são exigidas no ar.

segments.src: A thousand test hours for a shortened derivative of an already-certified airframe would have been unusual in 2016.
segments.tr: Mil horas de teste para um derivado encurtado de uma fuselagem já certificada teria sido incomum em 2016.

segments.src: In 2026 it is close to the expected cost of doing business.
segments.tr: Em 2026, isso está próximo do custo esperado para fazer negócios.

segments.src: ## Southwest's thirty parked airplanes
segments.tr: ## Os trinta aviões estacionados da Southwest

segments.src: The commercial arithmetic falls hardest on Southwest Airlines, the MAX 7's launch customer, which has roughly 30 completed aircraft sitting on the ground and will not begin taking deliveries until early 2027.
segments.tr: A aritmética comercial recai mais pesadamente sobre a Southwest Airlines, a cliente lançadora do MAX 7, que tem cerca de 30 aeronaves completas paradas no chão e não começará a receber entregas até o início de 2027.

segments.src: Those airframes represent capital that has been spent, insured, stored and maintained for years without producing a single block hour of revenue.
segments.tr: Essas fuselagens representam capital que foi gasto, segurado, armazenado e mantido por anos sem produzir uma única hora de bloco de receita.

segments.src: Southwest's response over the past several years has been to keep flying older 737-700s longer than planned and to convert part of its order book to the larger MAX 8 — a rational hedge that also quietly changed the shape of its network, since a bigger airplane needs more passengers per departure to make sense.
segments.tr: A resposta da Southwest nos últimos anos tem sido continuar voando com os 737-700s mais antigos por mais tempo do que o planejado e converter parte de sua carteira de pedidos para o MAX 8 maior — uma proteção racional que também mudou silenciosamente a forma de sua rede, já que um avião maior precisa de mais passageiros por partida para fazer sentido.

segments.src: The MAX 7's arrival lets the airline restart a fleet-renewal plan that has been frozen since the end of the last decade, but on a slower clock and with newer, more expensive money.
segments.tr: A chegada do MAX 7 permite que a companhia aérea reinicie um plano de renovação de frota que estava congelado desde o final da década passada, mas em um relógio mais lento e com dinheiro mais novo e mais caro.

segments.src: For Boeing, certification converts inventory into cash, which matters for a company that has spent years burning it.
segments.tr: Para a Boeing, a certificação converte inventário em dinheiro, o que importa para uma empresa que passou anos queimando-o.

segments.src: But deliveries in early 2027 also mean the revenue arrives against a production system still recovering from post-2024 output limits, and stored aircraft typically need inspection and update work before they can be handed over.
segments.tr: Mas as entregas no início de 2027 também significam que a receita chega contra um sistema de produção ainda se recuperando dos limites de produção pós-2024, e aeronaves armazenadas normalmente precisam de trabalho de inspeção e atualização antes de poderem ser entregues.

segments.src: ## What it signals for the MAX 10 — and for everything after
segments.tr: ## O que isso sinaliza para o MAX 10 — e para tudo o mais que vier

segments.src: The MAX 10, the longest member of the family, is still awaiting approval and faces the same crew-alerting condition and a distinct set of issues of its own, including its extending landing gear.
segments.tr: O MAX 10, o membro mais longo da família, ainda aguarda aprovação e enfrenta a mesma condição de alerta da tripulação e um conjunto distinto de problemas próprios, incluindo seu trem de pouso estendido.

segments.src: The MAX 7 outcome is the closest thing to a template available: expect the FAA to close every item rather than accept a deferral, and expect schedule commitments to be treated as forecasts rather than plans.
segments.tr: O resultado do MAX 7 é o mais próximo de um modelo disponível: espere que a FAA feche cada item em vez de aceitar um adiamento, e espere que os compromissos de cronograma sejam tratados como previsões em vez de planos.

segments.src: The wider question is what the right answer looks like.
segments.tr: A questão mais ampla é como é a resposta certa.

segments.src: Seven years of slippage on a derivative aircraft is not something anyone designed on purpose.
segments.tr: Sete anos de atraso em uma aeronave derivada não é algo que alguém projetou propositalmente.

segments.src: It is the accumulated cost of rebuilding a certification process whose credibility had been damaged, plus one genuine engineering surprise, plus a legislative requirement that arrived mid-program.
segments.tr: É o custo acumulado de reconstruir um processo de certificação cuja credibilidade havia sido danificada, mais uma surpresa genuína de engenharia, mais um requisito legislativo que chegou no meio do programa.

segments.src: Reasonable people read the same facts differently: one view is that the system is now working as intended and the delay is the price of not repeating a catastrophic failure; another is that a process this unpredictable discourages manufacturers from building safer new designs at all, because the regulatory timeline cannot be estimated in advance.
segments.tr: Pessoas razoáveis leem os mesmos fatos de maneiras diferentes: uma visão é que o sistema agora está funcionando conforme o pretendido e o atraso é o preço de não repetir uma falha catastrófica; outra é que um processo tão imprevisível desencoraja os fabricantes de construir novos projetos mais seguros, porque o cronograma regulatório não pode ser estimado com antecedência.

segments.src: Both can be true.
segments.tr: Ambos podem ser verdadeiros.

segments.src: What the MAX 7 demonstrates is that in the United States today, a certificate is issued when the last open item is closed — not when the delivery slot was booked.
segments.tr: O que o MAX 7 demonstra é que, nos Estados Unidos hoje, um certificado é emitido quando o último item em aberto é fechado — e não quando o espaço de entrega foi reservado.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## O que observar a seguir

segments.src: - **Entry into service.** Certification is not the same as flying passengers; route-proving, crew training and the FAA's operational approvals still stand between the certificate and the first ticketed flight.
segments.tr: - **Entrada em serviço.** Certificação não é o mesmo que voar com passageiros; provas de rota, treinamento da tripulação e aprovações operacionais da FAA ainda se interpõem entre o certificado e o primeiro voo com bilhete.

segments.src: - **Delivery pace through 2027.** How quickly stored airframes can be updated and handed over is a better indicator of Boeing's recovery than the certificate itself.
segments.tr: - **Ritmo de entrega até 2027.** Com que rapidez as fuselagens armazenadas podem ser atualizadas e entregues é um indicador melhor da recuperação da Boeing do que o próprio certificado.

segments.src: - **The MAX 10 decision.** Its treatment will show whether the MAX 7 review was a one-off catch-up or the new baseline.
segments.tr: - **A decisão do MAX 10.** Seu tratamento mostrará se a revisão do MAX 7 foi um evento único de recuperação ou a nova linha de base.

segments.src: - **Fleet-wide alerting upgrades.** The improvements attached to the 2022 congressional relief apply beyond one variant, and their rollout is the part of this story that touches airplanes already flying.
segments.tr: - **Atualizações de alerta em toda a frota.** As melhorias associadas ao alívio congressional de 2022 aplicam-se além de uma variante, e sua implantação é a parte desta história que toca aviões que já estão voando.

in.title: Terlambat Tujuh Tahun: Apa yang Diungkapkan oleh Persetujuan 737 MAX 7 FAA tentang Cara Amerika Mensertifikasi Pesawat Terbang

segments.src: On August 3, the Federal Aviation Administration issued an amended type certificate for the Boeing 737 MAX 7 — the smallest and, as it turned out, the slowest member of the MAX family to reach the finish line.
segments.tr: Pada tanggal 3 Agustus, Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) mengeluarkan sertifikat tipe yang diamandemen untuk Boeing 737 MAX 7 — anggota keluarga MAX terkecil dan, ternyata, yang paling lambat mencapai garis finis.

segments.src: The jet was supposed to be carrying passengers in 2019.
segments.tr: Jet ini seharusnya membawa penumpang pada tahun 2019.

segments.src: It will not carry a paying one until 2027.
segments.tr: Namun, ia tidak akan membawa penumpang berbayar hingga tahun 2027.

segments.src: That gap is the story.
segments.tr: Kesenjangan itulah yang menjadi ceritanya.

segments.src: The MAX 7 is not a new airplane in any meaningful engineering sense; it is a shortened version of a variant that was already certified in 2017.
segments.tr: MAX 7 bukanlah pesawat baru dalam arti teknik yang berarti; ia adalah versi pendek dari varian yang sudah disertifikasi pada tahun 2017.

segments.src: And yet it took longer to approve than most clean-sheet designs take to build.
segments.tr: Namun, proses persetujuannya memakan waktu lebih lama daripada waktu yang dibutuhkan sebagian besar desain baru untuk dibangun.

segments.src: Understanding why is a useful window into how aircraft certification in the United States actually works now — and how much it has changed since the last decade.
segments.tr: Memahami alasannya adalah jendela yang berguna untuk melihat bagaimana sertifikasi pesawat di Amerika Serikat sebenarnya bekerja sekarang — dan seberapa banyak hal itu telah berubah sejak dekade terakhir.

segments.src: ## A short jet with a long timeline
segments.tr: ## Jet pendek dengan lini masa yang panjang

segments.src: Boeing launched the MAX program in 2011 and the MAX 8 entered service in May 2017.
segments.tr: Boeing meluncurkan program MAX pada tahun 2011 dan MAX 8 mulai beroperasi pada Mei 2017.

segments.src: The MAX 9 followed.
segments.tr: MAX 9 menyusul kemudian.

segments.src: The MAX 7 — sized for thinner routes and shorter runways, and pitched to Southwest Airlines as the eventual replacement for its aging fleet of 737-700s — first flew in March 2018 and was, at the time, expected to be delivered within a year.
segments.tr: MAX 7 — yang berukuran untuk rute yang lebih tipis dan landasan pacu yang lebih pendek, dan ditawarkan kepada Southwest Airlines sebagai pengganti armada 737-700 yang sudah tua — terbang pertama kali pada Maret 2018 dan, pada saat itu, diperkirakan akan dikirimkan dalam waktu satu tahun.

segments.src: Then came the two fatal accidents, in October 2018 and March 2019, that claimed 346 lives and led to a worldwide grounding of the MAX fleet for roughly 20 months.
segments.tr: Kemudian terjadi dua kecelakaan fatal, pada Oktober 2018 dan Maret 2019, yang merenggut 346 nyawa dan menyebabkan penghentian operasional armada MAX di seluruh dunia selama kurang lebih 20 bulan.

segments.src: The MAX 8 and MAX 9 returned to service in late 2020 after a redesign of the flight-control system.
segments.tr: MAX 8 dan MAX 9 kembali beroperasi pada akhir 2020 setelah desain ulang sistem kontrol penerbangan.

segments.src: The MAX 7 did not simply resume its old certification track.
segments.tr: MAX 7 tidak sekadar melanjutkan jalur sertifikasi lamanya.

segments.src: It restarted it, under rules that no longer resembled the ones it began under.
segments.tr: Ia memulainya kembali, di bawah aturan yang tidak lagi menyerupai aturan saat ia dimulai.

segments.src: ## The three problems that had to be closed
segments.tr: ## Tiga masalah yang harus diselesaikan

segments.src: According to the certification announcement, the program logged more than 1,000 hours of flight and ground testing in its final phase.
segments.tr: Menurut pengumuman sertifikasi, program ini mencatat lebih dari 1.000 jam pengujian penerbangan dan darat dalam fase akhirnya.

segments.src: Three technical threads accounted for most of the delay.
segments.tr: Tiga utas teknis menjadi penyebab sebagian besar penundaan.

segments.src: **Flight-control software.** The system at the center of the 2018–2019 accidents, MCAS, was rewritten across the MAX fleet: it now compares both angle-of-attack sensors and stands down if they disagree, activates only once per event, and cannot override pilot input on the control column.
segments.tr: **Perangkat lunak kontrol penerbangan.** Sistem yang menjadi pusat kecelakaan 2018–2019, MCAS, ditulis ulang di seluruh armada MAX: sistem ini sekarang membandingkan kedua sensor sudut serang (angle-of-attack) dan berhenti jika keduanya tidak sesuai, aktif hanya sekali per kejadian, dan tidak dapat mengesampingkan input pilot pada kolom kontrol.

segments.src: The MAX 7 inherited that architecture, but inheriting it is not the same as being credited for it.
segments.tr: MAX 7 mewarisi arsitektur tersebut, tetapi mewarisinya tidak sama dengan mendapatkan kredit atas hal itu.

segments.src: Every change had to be re-validated against the specific aerodynamics and weight-and-balance envelope of a shorter fuselage.
segments.tr: Setiap perubahan harus divalidasi ulang terhadap aerodinamika spesifik dan amplop berat-dan-keseimbangan dari badan pesawat yang lebih pendek.

segments.src: **Crew alerting.** In December 2020, Congress passed the Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, which required aircraft certified after December 2022 to carry a modern engine-indicating and crew-alerting system — the kind that prioritizes and plainly names a failure rather than lighting several unrelated warnings at once.
segments.tr: **Peringatan kru.** Pada Desember 2020, Kongres mengesahkan Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, yang mengharuskan pesawat yang disertifikasi setelah Desember 2022 membawa sistem indikasi mesin dan peringatan kru modern — jenis yang memprioritaskan dan menamai kegagalan secara jelas daripada menyalakan beberapa peringatan yang tidak terkait sekaligus.

segments.src: The MAX 7's flight deck is deliberately built to be common with the rest of the 737 fleet, so meeting that requirement outright would have broken the pilot-commonality argument that makes the airplane attractive to airlines in the first place.
segments.tr: Dek pesawat MAX 7 sengaja dibangun agar sama dengan armada 737 lainnya, sehingga memenuhi persyaratan itu secara langsung akan merusak argumen kesamaan pilot yang membuat pesawat ini menarik bagi maskapai penerbangan sejak awal.

segments.src: Congress ultimately granted the MAX 7 and MAX 10 relief from the deadline in late 2022, on the condition that Boeing add a set of flight-deck and alerting improvements across the MAX line.
segments.tr: Kongres akhirnya memberikan keringanan tenggat waktu bagi MAX 7 dan MAX 10 pada akhir 2022, dengan syarat Boeing menambahkan serangkaian peningkatan dek penerbangan dan peringatan di seluruh lini MAX.

segments.src: Those improvements became part of what the FAA had to review.
segments.tr: Peningkatan tersebut menjadi bagian dari apa yang harus ditinjau oleh FAA.

segments.src: **Engine anti-ice.** The last and least expected obstacle was a nacelle.
segments.tr: **Anti-es mesin.** Hambatan terakhir dan yang paling tidak terduga adalah nacelle.

segments.src: Engineers determined that if the engine inlet anti-ice system were left running in dry air beyond a certain window, the composite inlet structure could overheat.
segments.tr: Insinyur menentukan bahwa jika sistem anti-es saluran masuk mesin dibiarkan berjalan di udara kering melampaui jendela waktu tertentu, struktur saluran masuk komposit dapat mengalami panas berlebih.

segments.src: Boeing asked the FAA in January 2024 for a time-limited exemption while it engineered a permanent fix, then withdrew the request weeks later amid public and congressional criticism that followed a separate in-flight panel failure on an Alaska Airlines MAX 9.
segments.tr: Boeing meminta pengecualian terbatas waktu kepada FAA pada Januari 2024 sementara ia merancang perbaikan permanen, lalu menarik permintaan tersebut beberapa minggu kemudian di tengah kritik publik dan kongres yang mengikuti kegagalan panel dalam penerbangan terpisah pada MAX 9 Alaska Airlines.

segments.src: The company committed instead to a hardware redesign.
segments.tr: Perusahaan tersebut berkomitmen untuk melakukan desain ulang perangkat keras sebagai gantinya.

segments.src: That decision was almost certainly correct on the merits, and it cost the program most of two years.
segments.tr: Keputusan itu hampir pasti benar secara substansi, dan itu memakan waktu hampir dua tahun bagi program tersebut.

segments.src: ## The quieter change: who does the certifying
segments.tr: ## Perubahan yang lebih tenang: siapa yang melakukan sertifikasi

segments.src: The most consequential shift is the one that does not show up in any single fix.
segments.tr: Pergeseran yang paling berdampak adalah pergeseran yang tidak muncul dalam perbaikan tunggal mana pun.

segments.src: For decades, the FAA delegated large portions of certification work to Boeing employees under an Organization Designation Authorization — a system that let a company find and approve much of its own compliance evidence.
segments.tr: Selama beberapa dekade, FAA mendelegasikan sebagian besar pekerjaan sertifikasi kepada karyawan Boeing di bawah Organization Designation Authorization — sebuah sistem yang memungkinkan perusahaan menemukan dan menyetujui sebagian besar bukti kepatuhannya sendiri.

segments.src: The 2020 reform law tightened that arrangement, adding FAA oversight of the delegated engineering unit, stronger protections for employees who raise safety concerns, and a requirement for a formal safety management system.
segments.tr: Undang-undang reformasi 2020 memperketat pengaturan tersebut, menambahkan pengawasan FAA terhadap unit teknik yang didelegasikan, perlindungan yang lebih kuat bagi karyawan yang menyampaikan kekhawatiran keselamatan, dan persyaratan untuk sistem manajemen keselamatan formal.

segments.src: The practical result is that fewer findings are accepted on paper and more are demanded in the air.
segments.tr: Hasil praktisnya adalah lebih sedikit temuan yang diterima di atas kertas dan lebih banyak yang diminta di udara.

segments.src: A thousand test hours for a shortened derivative of an already-certified airframe would have been unusual in 2016.
segments.tr: Seribu jam pengujian untuk turunan yang diperpendek dari rangka pesawat yang sudah disertifikasi akan menjadi hal yang tidak biasa pada tahun 2016.

segments.src: In 2026 it is close to the expected cost of doing business.
segments.tr: Pada tahun 2026, hal itu mendekati biaya operasional yang diharapkan.

segments.tr: ## Tiga puluh pesawat Southwest yang terparkir

segments.tr: ## Apa yang disinyalkan untuk MAX 10 — dan untuk semua setelahnya

segments.src: What the MAX 7 demonstrates is that in the United States today, a certificate is issued when the last open item is closed — not when the delivery slot was booked.
segments.tr: Apa yang ditunjukkan oleh MAX 7 adalah bahwa di Amerika Serikat saat ini, sertifikat dikeluarkan ketika item terbuka terakhir ditutup — bukan ketika slot pengiriman telah dipesan.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diperhatikan selanjutnya

segments.src: - **Entry into service.** Certification is not the same as flying passengers; route-proving, crew training and the FAA's operational approvals still stand between the certificate and the first ticketed flight.
segments.tr: - **Masuk ke layanan.** Sertifikasi tidak sama dengan menerbangkan penumpang; pembuktian rute, pelatihan kru dan persetujuan operasional FAA masih berdiri di antara sertifikat dan penerbangan berbayar pertama.

segments.src: - **Delivery pace through 2027.** How quickly stored airframes can be updated and handed over is a better indicator of Boeing's recovery than the certificate itself.
segments.tr: - **Kecepatan pengiriman hingga 2027.** Seberapa cepat rangka pesawat yang disimpan dapat diperbarui dan diserahkan adalah indikator pemulihan Boeing yang lebih baik daripada sertifikat itu sendiri.

segments.src: - **The MAX 10 decision.** Its treatment will show whether the MAX 7 review was a one-off catch-up or the new baseline.
segments.tr: - **Keputusan MAX 10.** Penanganannya akan menunjukkan apakah tinjauan MAX 7 adalah pengejaran satu kali atau standar baru.

segments.src: - **Fleet-wide alerting upgrades.** The improvements attached to the 2022 congressional relief apply beyond one variant, and their rollout is the part of this story that touches airplanes already flying.
segments.tr: - **Peningkatan peringatan seluruh armada.** Peningkatan yang melekat pada keringanan kongres 2022 berlaku di luar satu varian, dan peluncurannya adalah bagian dari cerita ini yang menyentuh pesawat yang sudah terbang.

ja.title: 7年遅れの承認：FAAの737 MAX 7承認が明かす、アメリカの航空機認証制度の現状

segments.src: On August 3, the Federal Aviation Administration issued an amended type certificate for the Boeing 737 MAX 7 — the smallest and, as it turned out, the slowest member of the MAX family to reach the finish line.
segments.tr: 8月3日、連邦航空局（FAA）はボーイング737 MAX 7の修正型式証明書を発行しました。これはMAXファミリーの中で最も小型で、結果的にゴールに到達するのが最も遅い機体となりました。

segments.src: The jet was supposed to be carrying passengers in 2019.
segments.tr: このジェット機は2019年に旅客輸送を開始する予定でした。

segments.src: It will not carry a paying one until 2027.
segments.tr: しかし、有料の乗客を運ぶのは2027年まで待つことになります。

segments.src: That gap is the story.
segments.tr: この空白期間こそが、この物語の本質です。

segments.src: The MAX 7 is not a new airplane in any meaningful engineering sense; it is a shortened version of a variant that was already certified in 2017.
segments.tr: MAX 7は、工学的な意味で新しい飛行機ではありません。2017年にすでに認証されたバリアントの短縮版であるためです。

segments.src: And yet it took longer to approve than most clean-sheet designs take to build.
segments.tr: それにもかかわらず、承認までに、ほとんどのクリーンシート設計の機体が製造されるよりも長い時間がかかりました。

segments.src: Understanding why is a useful window into how aircraft certification in the United States actually works now — and how much it has changed since the last decade.
segments.tr: その理由を理解することは、現在のアメリカにおける航空機認証が実際にどのように機能しているか、そして過去10年でどれほど変化したかを知るための有用な窓となります。

segments.src: ## A short jet with a long timeline
segments.tr: ## 短い機体と長いタイムライン

segments.src: Boeing launched the MAX program in 2011 and the MAX 8 entered service in May 2017.
segments.tr: ボーイングは2011年にMAXプログラムを開始し、MAX 8は2017年5月に就航しました。

segments.src: The MAX 9 followed.
segments.tr: 続いてMAX 9が就航しました。

segments.src: The MAX 7 — sized for thinner routes and shorter runways, and pitched to Southwest Airlines as the eventual replacement for its aging fleet of 737-700s — first flew in March 2018 and was, at the time, expected to be delivered within a year.
segments.tr: MAX 7は、需要の少ない路線や短い滑走路向けに設計され、サウスウエスト航空にとって老朽化した737-700の代替機として提案されました。2018年3月に初飛行し、当時は1年以内に納入される見込みでした。

segments.src: Then came the two fatal accidents, in October 2018 and March 2019, that claimed 346 lives and led to a worldwide grounding of the MAX fleet for roughly 20 months.
segments.tr: その後、2018年10月と2019年3月に2件の致命的な事故が発生し、346人の命が失われ、MAXファミリーは世界的に約20ヶ月間にわたり運航停止となりました。

segments.src: The MAX 8 and MAX 9 returned to service in late 2020 after a redesign of the flight-control system.
segments.tr: MAX 8とMAX 9は、飛行制御システムの再設計後、2020年後半に運航を再開しました。

segments.src: The MAX 7 did not simply resume its old certification track.
segments.tr: しかし、MAX 7は単に以前の認証プロセスに戻ったわけではありません。

segments.src: It restarted it, under rules that no longer resembled the ones it began under.
segments.tr: それは、開始時のルールとは似ても似つかない新しいルールのもとで、プロセスを再スタートさせたのです。

segments.src: ## The three problems that had to be closed
segments.tr: ## 解決すべきだった3つの問題

segments.src: According to the certification announcement, the program logged more than 1,000 hours of flight and ground testing in its final phase.
segments.tr: 認証発表によると、プログラムの最終段階では1,000時間以上の飛行および地上試験が記録されました。

segments.src: Three technical threads accounted for most of the delay.
segments.tr: 遅延の主な原因は、3つの技術的な問題でした。

segments.src: **Flight-control software.** The system at the center of the 2018–2019 accidents, MCAS, was rewritten across the MAX fleet: it now compares both angle-of-attack sensors and stands down if they disagree, activates only once per event, and cannot override pilot input on the control column.
segments.tr: **飛行制御ソフトウェア。** 2018年から2019年の事故の中心となったシステム、MCASは、MAXファミリー全体で書き直されました。現在は、2つの迎角センサーを比較し、不一致がある場合は作動せず、1つのイベントにつき1回のみ作動し、コントロールコラムへのパイロットの入力よりも優先されることはありません。

segments.src: The MAX 7 inherited that architecture, but inheriting it is not the same as being credited for it.
segments.tr: MAX 7は、そのアーキテクチャを継承しましたが、継承したことと、それがそのまま認められたことは別です。

segments.src: Every change had to be re-validated against the specific aerodynamics and weight-and-balance envelope of a shorter fuselage.
segments.tr: すべての変更点は、短い胴体の特定の空気力学および重量・バランスの範囲に対して再検証される必要がありました。

segments.src: **Crew alerting.** In December 2020, Congress passed the Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, which required aircraft certified after December 2022 to carry a modern engine-indicating and crew-alerting system — the kind that prioritizes and plainly names a failure rather than lighting several unrelated warnings at once.
segments.tr: **乗組員警告。** 2020年12月、連邦議会は「航空機認証・安全・責任法（ACSAA）」を可決しました。これにより、2022年12月以降に認証された航空機は、最新のエンジン表示および乗組員警告システムを搭載することが義務付けられました。これは、複数の無関係な警告を同時に点灯させるのではなく、故障を優先順位付けし、明確に名称を提示するシステムです。

segments.src: The MAX 7's flight deck is deliberately built to be common with the rest of the 737 fleet, so meeting that requirement outright would have broken the pilot-commonality argument that makes the airplane attractive to airlines in the first place.
segments.tr: MAX 7のフライトデッキは、他の737ファミリーと共通化されるよう意図的に設計されているため、この要件をそのまま満たそうとすると、航空会社にとっての魅力であるパイロットの共通性の議論が崩れてしまいます。

segments.src: Congress ultimately granted the MAX 7 and MAX 10 relief from the deadline in late 2022, on the condition that Boeing add a set of flight-deck and alerting improvements across the MAX line.
segments.tr: 最終的に連邦議会は、ボーイングがMAXライン全体にフライトデッキおよび警告システムの改善策を導入することを条件に、2022年後半にMAX 7とMAX 10に期限の免除を認めました。

segments.src: Those improvements became part of what the FAA had to review.
segments.tr: これらの改善策が、FAAが審査すべき内容の一部となりました。

segments.src: **Engine anti-ice.** The last and least expected obstacle was a nacelle.
segments.tr: **エンジン防氷。** 最後にして最も予想外の障害は、ナセルでした。

segments.src: Engineers determined that if the engine inlet anti-ice system were left running in dry air beyond a certain window, the composite inlet structure could overheat.
segments.tr: エンジニアは、エンジン吸気口の防氷システムを乾燥した空気の中で一定時間を超えて作動させ続けた場合、複合材の吸気口構造が過熱する可能性があることを突き止めました。

segments.src: Boeing asked the FAA in January 2024 for a time-limited exemption while it engineered a permanent fix, then withdrew the request weeks later amid public and congressional criticism that followed a separate in-flight panel failure on an Alaska Airlines MAX 9.
segments.tr: ボーイングは2024年1月に、恒久的な修正策を講じるまでの期間限定の免除をFAAに申請しましたが、アラスカ航空のMAX 9で発生した別の飛行中のパネル脱落事故後の世論と議会の批判を受け、数週間後に申請を撤回しました。

segments.src: The company committed instead to a hardware redesign.
segments.tr: 会社は代わりに、ハードウェアの再設計を約束しました。

segments.src: That decision was almost certainly correct on the merits, and it cost the program most of two years.
segments.tr: この決定は、実質的にほぼ間違いなく正しかったと言えますが、プログラムに約2年の時間を要することとなりました。

segments.src: ## The quieter change: who does the certifying
segments.tr: ## 静かな変化：誰が認証を行うか

segments.src: The most consequential shift is the one that does not show up in any single fix.
segments.tr: 最も重大な転換は、個別の修正点には現れないものです。

segments.src: For decades, the FAA delegated large portions of certification work to Boeing employees under an Organization Designation Authorization — a system that let a company find and approve much of its own compliance evidence.
segments.tr: 数十年にわたり、FAAは「組織指定承認（ODA）」に基づき、認証作業の大部分をボーイングの従業員に委任していました。これは、企業が自社のコンプライアンス証拠の多くを自ら発見し、承認することを認めるシステムでした。

segments.src: The 2020 reform law tightened that arrangement, adding FAA oversight of the delegated engineering unit, stronger protections for employees who raise safety concerns, and a requirement for a formal safety management system.
segments.tr: 2020年の改革法は、この取り決めを厳格化し、委任されたエンジニアリングユニットへのFAAの監視を強化し、安全上の懸念を提起した従業員への保護を強め、正式な安全管理システムの導入を義務付けました。

segments.src: The practical result is that fewer findings are accepted on paper and more are demanded in the air.
segments.tr: 実質的な結果として、書類上の認定は減り、実際の飛行による検証がより多く求められるようになりました。

segments.src: A thousand test hours for a shortened derivative of an already-certified airframe would have been unusual in 2016.
segments.tr: すでに認証された機体の短縮派生型に対して1,000時間の試験飛行を行うことは、2016年であれば異例のことだったでしょう。

segments.src: In 2026 it is close to the expected cost of doing business.
segments.tr: しかし2026年においては、それがビジネスを行う上での想定コストに近いものとなっています。

segments.src: ## Southwest's thirty parked airplanes
segments.tr: ## サウスウエスト航空の30機の待機機

segments.src: The commercial arithmetic falls hardest on Southwest Airlines, the MAX 7's launch customer, which has roughly 30 completed aircraft sitting on the ground and will not begin taking deliveries until early 2027.
segments.tr: 商業的な計算において最も打撃を受けたのは、MAX 7のローンチカスタマーであるサウスウエスト航空です。同社は約30機の完成機を地上に留めており、納入が始まるのは2027年初頭になります。

segments.src: Those airframes represent capital that has been spent, insured, stored and maintained for years without producing a single block hour of revenue.
segments.tr: これらの機体は、1ブロック時間分の収益も上げることなく、数年間にわたり支出され、保険にかけられ、保管・整備されてきた資本を表しています。

segments.src: Southwest's response over the past several years has been to keep flying older 737-700s longer than planned and to convert part of its order book to the larger MAX 8 — a rational hedge that also quietly changed the shape of its network, since a bigger airplane needs more passengers per departure to make sense.
segments.tr: ここ数年、サウスウエスト航空の対応は、計画よりも長く古い737-700を飛ばし続け、注文書の一部をより大型のMAX 8に変更することでした。これは合理的なヘッジでしたが、同時にネットワークの形状を静かに変えました。大型機は、1便あたりの乗客数を増やさなければ採算が合わないためです。

segments.src: The MAX 7's arrival lets the airline restart a fleet-renewal plan that has been frozen since the end of the last decade, but on a slower clock and with newer, more expensive money.
segments.tr: MAX 7の登場により、航空会社は前世紀末から凍結されていた機材更新計画を再開できますが、それはより遅いペースで、より高価な資金調達によるものとなります。

segments.src: For Boeing, certification converts inventory into cash, which matters for a company that has spent years burning it.
segments.tr: ボーイングにとって、認証は在庫を現金に変換することを意味し、それは数年間現金を使い果たしてきた会社にとって重要です。

segments.src: But deliveries in early 2027 also mean the revenue arrives against a production system still recovering from post-2024 output limits, and stored aircraft typically need inspection and update work before they can be handed over.
segments.tr: しかし、2027年初頭の納入は、2024年以降の生産制限からまだ回復している途中の生産システムの中で収益が発生することを意味し、保管されていた機体は通常、引き渡し前に点検とアップデート作業が必要になります。

segments.src: ## What it signals for the MAX 10 — and for everything after
segments.tr: ## MAX 10への示唆、そしてその後のすべてについて

segments.src: The MAX 10, the longest member of the family, is still awaiting approval and faces the same crew-alerting condition and a distinct set of issues of its own, including its extending landing gear.
segments.tr: ファミリーの中で最も長い機体であるMAX 10は、まだ承認を待っており、同様の乗組員警告条件と、伸長式ランディングギアなど、独自の個別の問題に直面しています。

segments.src: The MAX 7 outcome is the closest thing to a template available: expect the FAA to close every item rather than accept a deferral, and expect schedule commitments to be treated as forecasts rather than plans.
segments.tr: MAX 7の結果は、利用可能な最も近いテンプレートとなります。FAAは延期を認めるのではなく、すべての項目を完結させることを求め、スケジュールの約束は計画ではなく予測として扱われることが予想されます。

segments.src: The wider question is what the right answer looks like.
segments.tr: より広い問いは、何が正解なのかということです。

segments.src: Seven years of slippage on a derivative aircraft is not something anyone designed on purpose.
segments.tr: 派生機で7年の遅延が発生することは、誰も意図的に設計したことではありません。

segments.src: It is the accumulated cost of rebuilding a certification process whose credibility had been damaged, plus one genuine engineering surprise, plus a legislative requirement that arrived mid-program.
segments.tr: それは、信頼性が損なわれた認証プロセスを再構築するための蓄積されたコストであり、そこに本物の工学的サプライズと、プログラムの中盤で導入された法的要件が加わったものです。

segments.src: Reasonable people read the same facts differently: one view is that the system is now working as intended and the delay is the price of not repeating a catastrophic failure; another is that a process this unpredictable discourages manufacturers from building safer new designs at all, because the regulatory timeline cannot be estimated in advance.
segments.tr: 合理的な人々は、同じ事実を異なる視点から読み取ります。ある視点では、システムは意図通りに機能しており、遅延は壊滅的な失敗を繰り返さないための代償であると考えます。別の視点では、これほど予測不可能なプロセスは、規制上のタイムラインを事前に見積もることができないため、メーカーがより安全な新設計を構築することを妨げると考えます。

segments.src: Both can be true.
segments.tr: どちらも正解である可能性があります。

segments.src: What the MAX 7 demonstrates is that in the United States today, a certificate is issued when the last open item is closed — not when the delivery slot was booked.
segments.tr: MAX 7が証明したのは、現在のアメリカでは、納入枠が予約されたときではなく、最後の未解決項目が解決されたときに証明書が発行されるということです。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 今後注目すべき点

segments.src: - **Entry into service.** Certification is not the same as flying passengers; route-proving, crew training and the FAA's operational approvals still stand between the certificate and the first ticketed flight.
segments.tr: - **就航。** 認証は旅客輸送と同義ではありません。ルート証明、乗組員訓練、FAAの運航承認が、証明書発行から最初のチケット販売便までの間にまだ残っています。

segments.src: - **Delivery pace through 2027.** How quickly stored airframes can be updated and handed over is a better indicator of Boeing's recovery than the certificate itself.
segments.tr: - **2027年までの納入ペース。** 保管されていた機体がどれだけ早くアップデートされ、引き渡されるかは、証明書そのものよりもボーイングの回復のより良い指標となります。

segments.src: - **The MAX 10 decision.** Its treatment will show whether the MAX 7 review was a one-off catch-up or the new baseline.
segments.tr: - **MAX 10の決定。** その扱いが、MAX 7の審査が単発の追いつきだったのか、それとも新しい基準となったのかを示します。

segments.src: - **Fleet-wide alerting upgrades.** The improvements attached to the 2022 congressional relief apply beyond one variant, and their rollout is the part of this story that touches airplanes already flying.
segments.tr: - **全機材の警告アップグレード。** 2022年の連邦議会の免除に付随した改善策は、一つのバリアントを超えて適用され、その展開は、すでに飛行している機体に影響を与えるこの物語の一部となります。

segments.src: ## A short jet with a long timeline
segments.tr: ## Ein kurzes Flugzeug mit einem langen Zeitplan

segments.src: Boeing launched the MAX program in 2011 and the MAX 8 entered service in May 2017.
segments.tr: Boeing startete das MAX-Programm im Jahr 2011, und die MAX 8 nahm im Mai 2017 den Betrieb auf.

segments.src: The MAX 9 followed.
segments.tr: Die MAX 9 folgte.

segments.src: The MAX 7 — sized for thinner routes and shorter runways, and pitched to Southwest Airlines as the eventual replacement for its aging fleet of 737-700s — first flew in March 2018 and was, at the time, expected to be delivered within a year.
segments.tr: Die MAX 7 – ausgelegt für schwächere Routen und kürzere Landebahnen und Southwest Airlines als künftiger Ersatz für deren alternde Flotte von 737-700 angeboten – absolvierte im März 2018 ihren Erstflug und sollte damals innerhalb eines Jahres ausgeliefert werden.

segments.src: Then came the two fatal accidents, in October 2018 and March 2019, that claimed 346 lives and led to a worldwide grounding of the MAX fleet for roughly 20 months.
segments.tr: Dann ereigneten sich die beiden Abstürze im Oktober 2018 und März 2019, die 346 Menschenleben forderten und zu einem weltweiten Flugverbot für die MAX-Flotte von rund 20 Monaten führten.

segments.src: The MAX 8 and MAX 9 returned to service in late 2020 after a redesign of the flight-control system.
segments.tr: Die MAX 8 und MAX 9 kehrten Ende 2020 nach einer Überarbeitung des Flugsteuerungssystems in den Dienst zurück.

segments.src: The MAX 7 did not simply resume its old certification track.
segments.tr: Die MAX 7 nahm jedoch nicht einfach ihren alten Zertifizierungsweg wieder auf.

segments.src: It restarted it, under rules that no longer resembled the ones it began under.
segments.tr: Sie startete ihn neu, unter Regeln, die kaum noch Ähnlichkeit mit jenen hatten, unter denen sie begonnen hatte.
